jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Cloud and Connectors
jobs.loc: Flexible / Remote, Salt Lake City, UT
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.

This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

What you'll do

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX's Data Cloud and connector ecosystem.
  • Prioritize connector investments using customer demand, market context, strategic leverage, and the needs of downstream DX products.
  • Improve the end-to-end connector experience, including setup, authentication, configuration, data mapping, sync health, and troubleshooting.
  • Define product requirements for data quality, freshness, completeness, reliability, and transparency.
  • Partner closely with Engineering on the evolution of DX's unified data layer while maintaining a clear boundary between product direction and technical design.
  • Own the product capabilities that keep DX's demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
  • Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.
  • Know how the platform is performing across connector adoption, time to value, reliability, and customer satisfaction; investigate problems and drive the right improvements.
  • Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Originations & Growth
jobs.desc:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About The Role 

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead and evolve Koalafi’s Originations product and drive growth across our end-to-end apply & checkout experiences. that serve as the front door to financing for every customer. This is a high-impact role at the center of Koalafi’s strategy to accelerate growth by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive for consumers to finance their purchases across both online and in-store channels.  

This role is ideal for a product manager who thrives working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll set the direction for Originations by aligning diverse partners, from Risk and Compliance to Marketing and Sales, around a cohesive strategy that accelerates growth while maintaining a unified vision. 

What You’ll Do 

Define and drive the Originations roadmap 

  • Lead product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Originations product as an engine for growth
  • Develop the product strategy for apply & checkout flows that are reusable across diverse merchant and consumer contexts – such as a consumer’s mobile phone to a store owner’s point-of-sale system or e-commerce checkout integration 

Grow and optimize the Originations funnel 

  • Drive continuous funnel optimization by identifying conversion opportunities using quantitative data and qualitative insights to ship rapid improvements while balancing profitability and compliance
  • Grow Koalafi’s distribution across channels by partnering with cross-functional teams to design and ship frictionless experiences that work for both merchants and consumers 

Shape the product for rapid insight generation and experimentation 

  • Partner with analytics and engineering to instrument the funnel, generate actionable insights, and run A/B tests to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
  • Mentor other PMs and establish best practices for experimentation and funnel analysis across the broader organization 

Champion the customer experience 

  • Champion the customer, bringing curiosity and empathy to every decision to ensure the application experience meets real customer needs
  • Conduct user research and map consumer and merchant journeys to uncover usability gaps and unmet needs

Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.

  • Drive roadmap decisions across customer commitments, enterprise needs, architecture constraints, and commercial priorities

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, eCommerce
jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Set the product strategy, quarterly goals, and success metrics, and present progress against milestones to executive leadership and finance
  • Own the unit economics that define launch readiness (success metrics, traffic quality, funnel efficiency), and make the call on when the data supports scaling, pivoting, or stopping
  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in performance advertising: DSP, retargeting platform, measurement/MMP, or ad network e-commerce products
  • Hands-on depth in web and mobile identity and attribution: probabilistic matching (IP and device signals), pixels, server-to-server postbacks, and the practical constraints of browser privacy changes (ITP, fingerprinting protection) and ATT
  • A track record of carrying a product from beta to GA, inc

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy
jobs.desc:
About the team

StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated.
This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do.
This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.

You Will Get To

  • Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing.
  • Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts.
  • Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market.
  • Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing.
  • Navigate the structural tension between organic relevance and advertising products that are core to the business model - not a side constraint, but a daily design problem.
  • Set the measurement framework for search quality in a non-deterministic, AI-powered experience - defining what "good" looks like when you can't rely on clean A/B tests alone.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

jobs.desc:
Who We Are

KeepTruckin builds technology using the latest advancements in AI and computer vision to improve the safety and efficiency of businesses with vehicles. Over one million drivers and 100,000 companies across every industry trust KeepTruckin’s integrated platform to power their operations, prevent accidents and reduce costs.  

At KeepTruckin, we see our hard work rewarded in tangible ways every day, and we believe that intelligence is most powerful when paired with humility. We’re motivated by the opportunity to save lives on the road while impacting and improving every facet of multiple trillion-dollar industries that keep our physical economy moving. KeepTruckin is proud to be a Forbes Cloud 100 company, Forbes Best Startup Employer 2020, and an Inc Magazine Best Place to Work.

About the Role:

In this role, we’ll be relying on you to own the success of mission-critical initiatives that will drive rapid growth of our new Freight business. The Staff Product Manager for Freight will be responsible for developing impactful, innovative, and intuitive products to help trucking companies find, book, and manage their freight efficiently. The ideal candidate will have operating experience in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment, and will be an expert in driving strategic alignment and results among cross-functional stakeholders. You’ll have visibility across the organization and will be a key voice in one of the most exciting companies in the transportation industry. This role can be fully remote and reports to the head of KeepTruckin's New Vertical products.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner closely with our engineering, design, and data teams to develop new features and processes to drive growth, increase engagement, and increase retention across KeepTruckin’s Freight Marketplace
  • Partner with business leaders from stakeholder teams on formulation and execution of freight strategy, vision, and product roadmap
  • Get very close to our customers and develop a keen understanding of their needs and pain points
  • Own & grow product revenue by establishing and executing on product & go-to-market strategy
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to execute a successful launch

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management
  • High customer empathy, with a desire to get in the shoes of our customers
  • Have high “EQ”; be even-keeled, flexible, and able to quickly adapt to unexpected changes
  • Proven experience in delivering commercially successful software products
  • Be data-driven; you regularly seek out and use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and opinions
  • Be experienced in gaining the respect of software engineers and data scientists
  • Be an exceptional organizational bridge-builder, with the ability to influence other teams

Equinix Fabric is the world's leading Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) interconnection platform, operating across 65+ global metros and connecting enterprises, hyperscalers, and network service providers through carrier-class ethernet. The core ethernet layer - EPL, EVPL, and virtual connections - is the revenue engine at the heart of Fabric.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own this core ethernet services portfolio, spanning Fabric EPL/EVPL virtual connections, port and LAG management, service tokens, and Equinix Metro Connect (Fabric Metro Connect). This leader will shape how customers consume physical and virtual Layer 2 connectivity through a simpler, more unified portfolio to improve customer experience and strengthen Fabric's position as the default interconnection platform for cloud, AI, and enterprise networking.

Drive the ethernet services product toward higher speeds (400G+), broader metro availability, and richer service types (E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree, multipoint)

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Professional Experience
jobs.desc:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com.

The role

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You'll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it's working, and you'll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you'll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.
  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.
  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.
  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.
  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you'll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.
  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.
  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.
  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.
  • A strong track record partnering across team boundaries you don't fully control.

Perks of working for ShiftKey

  • Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.
  • Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
  • Benefits begin on your first day.
  • Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

#LI-Remote

Our Commitment to Diversity

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive.

EEO Statement

KeepTruckin builds technology using the latest advancements in AI and computer vision to improve the safety and efficiency of businesses with vehicles. Over one million drivers and 100,000 companies across every industry trust KeepTruckin’s integrated platform to power their operations, prevent accidents and reduce costs.

jobs.desc:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery - agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

You Will Get To

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production
  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy
  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute
  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome
  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey
  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, and execution of a core product squad. In this role, you’ll lead engineers and designers to ship high-quality, high-impact features that improve contractor workflows, while connecting product decisions to measurable business and growth outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong product mindset with customer obsession and a high bar for execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the squad roadmap, strategy, and execution for a core product area.
  • Conduct continuous customer discovery - interviews, prototypes, field visits - and turn insights into clear specs, user stories, and priorities.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to iterate quickly and deliver intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Define adoption, activation, and retention metrics; set up tracking, analyze performance, and iterate based on data.
  • Produce and update our roadmap and communicate product direction across leadership and GTM teams.
  • Translate features into benefits and customer outcomes, supporting sales, marketing, and onboarding with clear collateral.
  • Sweat the details - QA, polish, and validate every flow and edge case before launch.
  • Apply Handoff’s product principles - simplemaxxing, mobile-first, AI-first, and customer-obsession - to every design, feature, and product decision

About you

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in vertical SaaS.
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products; with AI experience strongly preferred.
  • Track record of shipping 0→1 or early-stage features.
  • Strong skills in customer discovery, research, and ruthless prioritization.
  • Proven ability to work hand-in-hand with engineers and designers in agile environments.
  • Excellent writing and communication - able to produce crisp specs, epics, and roadmap docs.
  • Excitement about construction, remodeling, and home services - genuine curiosity about contractors’ world.
  • Bonus experience: CRM, project management tools, payments/fintech, AI-driven products, or PLG (product-led growth).
  • Startup DNA - comfort in ambiguity, bias for action, stamina for fast-moving environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA)
  • Relocation Allowance
  • Top-Notch Equipment
  • Team Offsites

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Kiss My Apps — компанія-платформа, що об’єднує 7 продуктових вертикалей та 30+ AI-first продуктів, 100+ мільйонів користувачів, власну екосистему аналітичних, пеймент та маркетингових розробок.

Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо Lead Product Manager, того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль:

Шукаємо Lead Product Manager, який(а) очолить розвиток одного з наших AI-driven застосунків на ринку, що активно зростає. Це роль із повним ownership за результат продукту — від формування продуктової стратегії до масштабування growth-каналів.

Наші продукти вже мають підтверджений product-market fit і значний потенціал кратного зростання. Твоя задача — знайти та оптимізувати робочу юніт-економіку, вибудувати системний процес продуктових експериментів і масштабувати продукт через продуктову розробку та performance-маркетинг.

Ця роль для людини, яка хоче не просто підтримувати існуючий продукт, а драйвити його масштабування, впливати на ключові метрики бізнесу та будувати продукт із потенціалом стати флагманом у своїй ніші.

Твої задачі:

  • Визначення продуктової та growth-стратегії для масштабування.

  • Пошук і стабілізація юніт-економіки продукту: pricing, paywall, retention, acquisition та ключові продуктові метрики.

  • Побудова системного процесу продуктових експериментів для зростання revenue та масштабування продукту.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Your role

As Lead Product Manager, you will own a set of Saturn's product areas in their entirety: strategy, roadmap, commercial outcomes, and the product managers who build them.a

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed company building the AI-native operating system for financial advice. Our platform combines a living data model of the client, AI agents that complete complex advice and operational workflows, and compliance logic embedded directly into how work is produced. The initial wedge is adviser productivity. The larger opportunity is rebuilding the operating model of the advice firm around connected data, intelligent workflows and continuous regulatory control.

This is a lead role with founder-level scope. You work directly with the CEO, engineers, partnerships, and associate product managers. You define the what and why with enough clarity that one engineer ships the whole feature. No handoff chain, no ambiguity, no hand-waving. Your work will determine whether Saturn becomes the intelligence layer through which advice is created, governed and delivered.

The Team

You will work in a cross-functional squad alongside Product Engineers who own features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and AI, plus Design and Saturn’s domain experts: chartered compliance officers and paraplanners. Product management at Saturn moves fast, and we protect that pace deliberately. The best PMs do their best work when they can see the impact of what they ship.

What You'll Work On

  • Owning the product strategy and a rolling 3-6 month roadmap for AI agents that automate advice workflows
  • Translating agentic and LLM capabilities into experiences advisers trust with regulated work, where evidence and auditability sit behind every material output
  • Running independent discovery with advisers and paraplanners, distinguishing signal from noise, and turning adviser pain into product direction
  • Prioritising ruthlessly across features, bugs, and quality, and writing specs with zero ambiguity — clear enough for one engineer to ship the whole feature
  • Balancing enterprise partner demands with product coherence, and sequencing releases against the go-to-market calendar
  • Treating go-to-market as part of the build. You ship features that land, not features that launch
  • Coaching and multiplying the PMs around you, and building the frameworks the product function adopts as it grows

What We're Looking For

  • Product management experience at fast-paced, product-led B2B SaaS companies, including ownership of a product that shipped and won in market
  • AI-native product experience. You've shipped products where AI is the core, not a bolt-on. You understand the difference between deterministic and probabilistic systems, and what it takes to put agentic workflows in front of users in a regulated environment
  • Technical fluency. You can discuss AI architecture trade-offs, know why prompts break, and challenge engineering assumptions
  • Discovery discipline and sharp prioritisation. You have run research that changed what got built, and you can explain why you said no — not just what you said yes to
  • Commercial instinct. You connect product decisions to retention, expansion, and the revenue model
  • Self-sufficiency with data. You define your own metrics and design your own experiments
  • Strong written communication. Your decision docs and PRDs reduce meetings rather than create them

Preferred

  • Fintech or regulated industry experience

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.desc:
GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300+ colleges, universities, and K-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition-free.

GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we’re also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we’ve made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies each of the last five years and we’ve been profitable nine of the last 10. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. 

Our purpose-driven team of 130+ is located in 30+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. 

While we operate at meaningful scale, we’re still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast-growing, mission-driven company, you’ll fit right in.


Location: This is a remote-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company-wide and team-specific onsites throughout the year.

Data is the foundation of everything GiveCampus is becoming. Our fastest-growing products—GC Intelligence, GC GO, personalized Outreach, Smart Ask—only deliver their value when a school's complete data is flowing into GiveCampus and back out to the systems they run their work in. Today, that flow is the single biggest thing standing between our 1,500+ Partner schools and the value we've promised them: integration friction is the number one blocker to going live, it shows up across every CRM and deal stage, and only a fraction of schools are sending us the full data our products are built to use. Closing that gap is one of the biggest growth and retention levers in front of the company.

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to own data and integrations end-to-end—not just the roadmap, but the outcome: schools actually sending us their complete data, reliably, at scale. You'll be accountable for whether that number moves, and you'll drive everything required to move it on the product side: strategy, discovery, execution, shipping quality and velocity, reliability, activation and onboarding, and the third-party vendors and integrations that sit in the flow. You'll do it across a wide range of CRMs (Blackbaud RE NXT and BB CRM, Salesforce / Ascend, Ellucian, Veracross, Slate) and a wide range of schools—from a 2-person K-12 advancement shop to a 500-person university team. Engineering is one big input, and a critical one—but it isn't the whole job. The whole job is making the movement of data between GiveCampus and our Partners so seamless and trustworthy that adoption stops being gated on it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
FirstWork is a forward-deployed applied-AI company for frontline hiring, the largest and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One platform carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training and payroll, for enterprise customers across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages. Our AI agents run that work rather than assisting someone who still does it: document agents validate credentials against policy, browsing agents operate government portals that have no API, and voice agents screen and follow up with candidates.

The scale is live, at roughly 50,000 new applicants a week and 2.5 million API requests a day. We bill on usage, per document validated and per agent action executed, so throughput and cost show up directly in revenue.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a product line, the platform primitives beneath it, and the AI capabilities that run on top.

What you'll do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and commercial shape for a product line or platform portfolio.

  • Integrate LLMs and agentic AI deeper into the product architecture.

  • Innovate and enhance product capabilities, from new feature development to improving the maturity, accuracy and performance of existing features.

  • Build new product lines from zero, taking a validated use case to a general, multi-tenant product.

  • Decide which capabilities are assistive and which are autonomous, and set the evidence standard each must meet before acting without human review.

  • Draw the boundary between deterministic, auditable rules and model-based judgement.

  • Decide what becomes a shared platform primitive, what stays customer configuration, and what we decline to build.

  • Own accuracy and evaluation infrastructure across the portfolio, including regression detection during scale-up.

  • Own packaging, pricing and unit economics, including model cost and margin.

  • Own the audit, evidence and explainability layer that operators and auditors depend on.

  • Hire and coach product managers, and set the standard for specifications, decision records and design review.

  • Represent the product in enterprise procurement, security review and AI governance discussions.

What we look for

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including senior ownership of a platform or multi-product portfolio in B2B or enterprise software.

  • Experience platformising a complex workflow product: extracting primitives, exposing them as configuration, and moving a second segment or vertical onto them without forking.

  • Production experience with LLM or agentic systems, including ownership of accuracy, cost, latency, fallback design and autonomy decisions.

  • A track record of both zero-to-one launches and scaling an established line past its first plateau.

  • Strong technical judgement across data models, decision logic, throughput and agent architecture. This is not a functional product role.

  • Commercial fluency across pricing, packaging, margin and cost to serve.

  • Experience in a regulated domain, with judgement on when to be conservative and when to escalate to legal.

  • Experience developing product managers, as a manager or as a senior individual contributor.

  • Influence through writing and demonstrated results rather than authority.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
San Francisco, CA · Full-time · In person

Screenpipe gives AI agents memory of your work. It keeps raw computer history local by default and makes that context available to the AI tools you choose.

We're looking for a senior PM who can make a powerful technical product simple and useful in everyday work.

You'll work directly with the founder and engineers, owning the path from understanding a customer's problem to shipping a change and seeing whether it helped.

What you'll own

  • Customer discovery. Talk to users regularly, watch them use the product, and understand what they are trying to get done.
  • The customer journey. Help people move from installing Screenpipe to getting a useful result and making it part of their routine.
  • Product priorities. Combine interviews, support feedback and product data to decide what matters next and what can wait.
  • Delivery. Turn problems into clear flows, prototypes and scoped work. Stay involved through implementation, release and follow-up.
  • Product outcomes. Define meaningful activation and retention measures, run focused experiments, and check whether changes improve real usage.
  • Trust. Treat privacy, permissions and clear explanations as part of the user experience.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned a software product end to end and can explain what you personally shipped, why you chose it and what happened afterward.
  • You have strong UX judgment and know how to test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're comfortable with product analytics, funnels and cohorts, including questioning how a metric is defined.
  • You can use AI tools to investigate problems and build prototypes, and work closely with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and can make decisions with incomplete information.
  • You're based in San Francisco and want to work together in person.

Experience with early-stage products, desktop software, developer tools or AI agents is useful.

Why Screenpipe

This is a chance to shape how people use AI with the context of their actual work. You'll have direct access to users, a public codebase to learn from, and room to carry an idea from discovery through to a working product.

Benefits

  • Health and recovery: Personal health coach or trainer, gym membership, sauna and cold plunge access, and unlimited massages.
  • Health insurance: Top-tier health insurance.
  • Flexibility: San Francisco is our home base, with flexibility to work remotely from time to time, including trips abroad such as Thailand.
  • Learning: Unlimited books and audiobooks, on us.
  • AI tools: $20,000 per month in AI tokens to build, experiment, and do your best work.
  • Personal growth: Career and life coaching.
  • Team travel: Team trips and work retreats, including places like Hawaii.

Compensation

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 per year. Equity range: 0.25% to 1.00% on a fully diluted basis. Final compensation depends on experience and role scope. Any equity grant is subject to board approval, equity plan terms, vesting and definitive documents.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, PBM Platform
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

  

Rightway is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own claims adjudication, the system at the center of Rightway's PBM. Adjudication covers the full lifecycle of a pharmacy claim: eligibility, coverage, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits. It is one of the most complex and consequential product areas at Rightway, and this role owns its strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

You will develop deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate today and use that to define where the platform goes next — working through real claim behavior alongside engineering, writing requirements precise enough to build against, setting the bar for correctness, and owning the validation approach that proves the system is ready for production volume. The role reports to the Director, Product Management, and operates with a high degree of independence. It requires someone who can take full ownership of a major product initiative and work cross-functionally across product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plan for claims adjudication, including how it scales with volume, new clients, and new lines of business
* Build deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate across eligibility, coverage rules, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits, and turn that into a structured, prioritized plan
* Define the long-term strategy for how the platform evolves to support operational scale, regulatory requirements, and new lines of business, including Medicare
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can execute against, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination in an agile environment
* Partner day to day with the adjudication engineering team to sequence work, manage dependencies, and resolve ambiguity in claim behavior quickly
* Set the bar for correctness and own the testing and claim certification approach that proves the system is ready for production volume
* Own readiness and rollout planning, including validation against real claim volume, parallel testing, and phased release
* Coordinate go-live readiness across operations, clinical, client success, and compliance so changes land without disruption to members or clients
* Partner with PBM operations, clinical, legal, and client success teams to ensure the platform meets workflow and regulatory requirements
* Manage the drug data, formulary, and prior authorization dependencies adjudication relies on, treating the internal teams who own them as first-class partners
* Define and track KPIs for claim accuracy, system performance, and reliability
* Act as the primary product point of contact for adjudication across the organization and with external partners

**WHO YOU ARE:**

  

* Bachelor's degree required; 5 or more years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare or enterprise technology
* Experience with complex, rules-driven transaction processing systems such as claims adjudication, payments, or benefit administration, including responsibility for correctness and testing
* Experience leading a platform migration or major system transition from requirements through go-live
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving product, engineering, legal, and operations stakeholders
* Ability to work independently and drive execution with minimal direction
* Strong communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams
* Detail oriented and process focused, and comfortable in a domain where correctness is measured claim by claim
* Comfortable working across complex, data-heavy systems
* Curious and adaptable, willing to dig into unfamiliar and highly technical territory and find answers
* Experience working in or with PBMs, pharmacy claims, or pharmacy operations is a plus
* Familiarity with systems that support regulated healthcare markets

An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, DGX Cloud - Trust Services
jobs.desc:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead Trust Services programs for DGX Cloud. DGX Cloud powers large-scale AI infrastructure across NVIDIA, cloud service providers, and NVIDIA Cloud Partners, making trust, integrity, and operational resilience critical to customer success. This role will drive the program structure needed to ensure we are running our infrastructure in known-good configurations across firmware, platform, and runtime environments. The work sits at the intersection of trust services, infrastructure security, product security, compliance, engineering execution, and partner readiness. This is a highly cross-functional role focused on turning trust and security requirements into clear roadmaps and execution plans..

What you'll be doing:

Lead Trust Services programs across DGXCloud, including program charter, PLC execution, roadmap, achievements, risks, and cross-functional alignment.

Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, DevOps, CSPs, and NCPs to establish and implement trust service standards across firmware, platform, and software teams.

Establish program structure through Jira, Confluence, roadmap artifacts, operating rhythms, dashboards, and governance reviews.

Coordinate development and rollout plans across partners and customers, ensuring clear signals that services are operating in a known-good state.

Build executive-ready updates, risk summaries, and decision materials that clarify scope, ownership, progress, blockers, and customer impact.

What we need to see:

12+ years of technical program management experience driving complex infrastructure, trust services, security, compliance, or software engineering programs in fast-paced environments.

Proven success leading cross-functional trust, security, risk, compliance, or platform programs across cloud IaaS, SaaS, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering.

Strong understanding of infrastructure trust and security concepts such as attestation, firmware/platform integrity, access control, vulnerability management, patching, and secrets management.

Experience driving programs through formal product or software lifecycle processes, including scope definition, requirements, roadmap planning, execution tracking, and release readiness.

Ability to bring together Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and partner teams around shared requirements, ownership, key achievements, and measurable outcomes.

Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, dashboards, and program artifacts used to manage execution, governance, and audit readiness.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical and compliance topics for senior collaborators.

MS in EE, CS, or related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

Experience with GPU infrastructure, confidential computing, device trust, firmware security, or hardware/software trust models.

Working knowledge of major cloud platforms.

Experience using automation, telemetry, and dashboards to improve compliance operations and trust posture.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share.

The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that.

Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose-driven for the organization it serves.

**Let's achieve more, together.**

**Where this role sits**
========================

This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds.

You lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces.

You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone.

**Why this role exists**
========================

In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing.

Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details.

The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves.

**What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)**
===============================================

You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure.

**1. Product strategy and roadmap ownership**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals.
* Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn.
* Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features.

**2. Discovery and definition**
-------------------------------

* Run discovery with members, buyers, and internal experts to understand the real problem before committing to a solution.
* Write clear definitions of what to build and why, including the assumptions and the bet behind each one.
* Validate early and often, so the team learns fast and adjusts faster.

**3. Delivery and execution**
-----------------------------

* Lead a cross-functional team through delivery, unblocking decisions and keeping momentum.
* Own trade-offs on scope, quality, and time, and make them explicit.
* Ship reliably, and hold a clear bar for what launch-ready means.

**4. AI product judgment**
--------------------------

* Make sound calls about where AI helps, where it fails, and how to design for its limits.
* Design for trust: provenance, guardrails, and honest handling of uncertainty in what the platform tells members.
* Partner with applied AI and research to turn capability into dependable product behavior.

**5. Member trust and outcomes**
--------------------------------

* Keep member value and trust at the center of every decision.
* Define the outcomes your area is accountable for, and measure them honestly.
* Own adoption and time-to-value, not just sh

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Design for Manufacturability (DFM)
jobs.desc:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Every custom part Xometry quotes has to be checked for manufacturability before it can become a job, i.e. Design for Manufacturing (DFM). As Staff Product Manager for DFM, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how Xometry defines, automates, and scales manufacturability review through AI across all geographies. This is a technical, cross-functional, high-ownership role at the intersection of manufacturing domain expertise, workflow design, and applied AI/ML — a critical component of our overall strategy.

**How You'll Contribute:**

* **Vision & strategy:** Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for DFM across Xometry — one global workbench enabling both staff and AI reviewers to accelerate the quality and speed of our custom parts production lifecycle. The near-term roadmap starts with foundational work — assigning and routing orders to the right DFM engineer — before scaling into the AI-driven workbench
* **Own the Intelligent DFM Workbench:** Lead the product that houses the single structured record of what each order requires to be built correctly — the source of truth read and edited by internal Staff, and viewed by Buyers and Partners through role-specific views
* **Partner with data science and ML engineering:** Work with data science and engineering to improve manufacturability models — 3D geometry analysis, and evaluation of Visual/3D Language Models for part understanding — and to build the champion/challenger and golden-dataset feedback loop that improves record accuracy over time from every workbench review
* **Drive measurable outcomes:** Define and track the metrics that matter — DFM handle time, sign-off latency, the gap between what's promised on paper and what's actually captured before a job starts, RMA rate, and regional rework — and use them to prioritize the roadmap
* **Lead cross-functionally:** Act as the hub between Engineering, Data Science, UX, Sourcing, Pricing, Order Systems, Quality, and DFM engineers/case managers, and present strategy, trade-offs, and ROI to executive leadership

**What You'll Bring to Xometry:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including leading AI/ML-powered or technical products in a B2B, marketplace, or manufacturing/engineering environment
* Experience owning a system of record or complex data contract (e.g., a shared record consumed by multiple downstream systems and roles) and the human-in-the-loop workflows built around it
* Experience designing policy-driven workflows (e.g., approval routing, tiered sign-off, escalation logic) rather than single-user tools
* Comfort operating across regions and stakeholder groups to hold a single global design standard, despite real pressure to add customizations
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill technical and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike
* Rigorous, data-driven approach to prioritization, experimentation, and measuring impact on cycle time, quality, and customer/partner satisfaction
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes and DFM principles (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection molding) is a strong plus; comfort getting deep into geometry-based feasibility rules is required
* Track record partnering closely with data science and ML engineering teams to ship models into production — computer vision, 3D/geometric analysis, or applied LLM/VLM experience is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree (MBA, MS) a plus

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.desc:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**
------------

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

You will own our enterprise product: the roadmap for what large customers need, and the control plane that makes it possible. These are the capabilities that decide whether a large customer can adopt us, trust us, and expand with us.

Our product is an API, and our enterprise buyer is an engineering organization. The people you build for are platform teams, architects, and the developers inside those companies who are putting agents into production. You need to be comfortable making product decisions about API surfaces, developer workflows, and technical tradeoffs, not only about business requirements.

To build this well, you have to be in the room. You will work alongside customer success, sales, and our forward-deployed engineers, who are in these accounts every week and already know where we fall short, and you will spend real time with customers alongside them. Delivery and implementation stay with forward-deployed engineering and go-to-market. Your job is to turn what you learn into product.

The hard part is judgment. Knowing which request is one account's edge case, and which one is the thing every enterprise customer will ask for six months from now. Getting that right is the difference between a platform and a pile of custom work.

In your first year, we expect you to own a clear enterprise roadmap, ship the controls that block deals today, and become the person the go-to-market team comes to before a deal gets stuck.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. The product team is small, so you will work directly with the engineers building your roadmap and with the go-to-market teams selling it.

**Your responsibilities will include**
--------------------------------------

* Own the enterprise roadmap: what we build for large customers, in what order, and why.
* Own the platform behind it: organizations and identity, keys and quotas, spend controls, usage observability and audit, policy enforcement, and data residency.
* Make product decisions on our API surface for enterprise use, so that the developers inside those accounts can build on us without friction.
* Work with customer success, sales, and forward-deployed engineering to understand what enterprise customers need, and spend time in accounts alongside them to see it first hand.
* Tell the difference between a single-account request and a pattern worth building for, and be able to defend the call either way.
* Hand off what belongs to another product area, with the evidence that makes it actionable.
* Give sales and marketing the positioning, materials, and product understanding they need to sell a technical product well.
* Represent enterprise customers in roadmap decisions with evidence rather than anecdote.

**We expect you to have**
-------------------------

**About Us**:

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

**This role in one paragraph**:

Build the platform that powers every Zeitview product. Own the core data model and shared platform services that enable data capture, processing, analysis, and delivery across Zeitview’s products and verticals. Define how domain objects and large-scale geospatial, imagery, inspection, and operational datasets are represented, connected, processed, governed, and exposed to applications, customers, and AI systems. This is a technical, high-leverage product role for someone who cares about building reliable, scalable, extensible systems. You’ll work closely with product engineering, data engineering, data science, security, and product teams to turn fragmented systems and data into durable platform primitives that teams can build on with confidence.

* Own the roadmap for shared platform services and data capabilities.
* Work across product teams to understand platform needs, unblock high-value use cases, and drive consistency without unnecessarily constraining product innovation.

* Improve how application teams discover, understand, and consume shared capabilities.
* Define standards for data quality, lineage, governance, discoverability, documentation, reliability, and developer experience.
* Identify where shared capabilities should be standardized at the platform layer versus owned within individual products or verticals.
* Evaluate how AI and agent-based systems should interact with Zeitview’s data and platform capabilities, including the primitives required to make those systems reliable and scalable.
* Define success metrics for platform investments and measure adoption, reliability, reuse, and business impact.

**This Role Is Not**:

* An infrastructure-only role. You will work on deeply technical systems, but your job is to ensure those systems enable better products and customer outcomes.
* A data engineering role. You will not design or operate pipelines yourself, but you must understand systems well enough to make informed product and architectural decisions.
* A centralized gatekeeper role. The goal is to create shared primitives that make teams faster, not introduce unnecessary process or control.
* A single-product role. Your customers are application teams, engineers, data practitioners, AI systems, and ultimately customers who depend on platform capabilities.

* 8+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in product management.
* Meaningful experience owning technical platform, data, infrastructure, developer, or AI-enabling products.

------------------

The Rich Media group aims to create a real estate buying and renting experience where every mover can get a deep sense of a home online and reimagine it as their own. At Synapse Health, we're streamlining the durable medical equipment (DME) process. We manage intake, documentation, routing, claims, billing, and patient support. Our model reshapes how DME is delivered and experienced.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. By taking on operational and financial complexity, we're redefining how DME works for providers, prescribers, and patients. We are proud to offer ***work that matters, on a mission that*** ***matter******s*****.**

**What We Need**

We're seeking a **Senior Product Manager, RCM Strategy** to own and advance the future-state product strategy for Revenue Cycle Management across the order lifecycle. As Synapse continues to scale, RCM represents a complex and financially critical area of the business. This role will provide dedicated Product leadership to understand current-state challenges, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and design scalable solutions that support continued growth, improve operational performance, and reduce financial and administrative friction.

This role combines strategic discovery and product execution. You will develop product points of view and translate complex financial, operational, and user needs into a clear product strategy and roadmap. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, RCM Operations, Finance, and leadership to shape the roadmap, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive products from problem identification through delivery and iteration.

This is an individual contributor role with high visibility and strategic importance as Synapse continues to expand. Success requires the ability to operate independently in ambiguity while connecting near-term product execution to longer-term scalability.

**What You Will Do**

**RCM Strategy & Future-State Design**

* Develop and articulate a future-state product strategy for RCM across the order lifecycle, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce financial and operational friction, and enable scalable growth.
* Lead deep discovery across RCM workflows, systems, data flows, and user experiences to identify root causes, unmet needs, scalability constraints, and opportunities for product innovation.
* Develop clear product points of view and recommendations for future-state capabilities, balancing business impact, user needs, technical considerations, and operational feasibility.
* Identify opportunities to connect, simplify, or modernize fragmented RCM capabilities, workflows, integrations, and data flows.
* Partner with senior leaders to align on product direction, investment priorities, sequencing, and key tradeoffs.

**Business & Financial Impact**

* Partner with RCM Operations, Finance, Data, and business leaders to understand and quantify the financial and operational impact of current-state processes, product gaps, and manual work.
* Evaluate opportunities based on measurable business outcomes, including scalability, efficiency, quality, revenue cycle performance, and cost to serve.
* Translate complex financial, operational, and business problems into clear product strategies, requirements, and scalable solutions.
* Use data, user insights, and business context to build compelling product recommendations and support investment decisions.

**Product Roadmap & Execution**

* Define and evolve the RCM product roadmap, prioritizing capabilities and solutions based on business impact, scalability, user needs, technical considerations, and the future-state product strategy.
* Lead product execution from discovery and requirements through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Manage the product backlog, lead grooming sessions, and drive sprint planning and execution with a dedicated engineering team

jobs.desc:
Infobase exists to power informed decisions. For decades, schools, libraries, and institutions have turned to our resources to build information literacy and help learners develop the skills they need to succeed long after the classroom. We build the platforms and content that make that possible, and right now we're growing the team behind them.

### **Job Summary**

The Senior Product Manager brings rigorous product management practice to bear on Infobase’s most ambiguous and complex product problems, working on a flexible, problem-driven basis rather than owning a single product area on an ongoing basis. The role partners closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy for their franchises — and with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition of new products and major product revisions on Infobase’s platform.

This is a senior individual-contributor role: for each assigned problem, the Senior Product Manager sets direction, builds the evidence base and business case behind major investments, and leads cross-functional alignment — including with Franchise Owners, the Senior Director, Platform Strategy, and Technology stakeholders — to move initiatives from strategy through adoption. Success depends on building alignment and driving outcomes through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. This role will create presentations for executive leadership and should be comfortable interfacing with all levels of the organization.

### **Scope & Assignment**

Assignments are based on the ambiguity and complexity of the business problem to solve — for example, defining a franchise’s multi-year evolution or transforming a franchise’s business model to withstand market shifts — rather than a fixed product line or market area. The Senior Product Manager moves successively between Infobase’s highest-priority strategic problems as they are identified, in partnership with the Chief Product Officer (CPO).

Franchise Owners hold steady-state, franchise-scope titles and retain ownership of content strategy and identity within their franchise on an ongoing basis. The Senior Product Manager and Franchise Owners work in close partnership on assigned problems, each bringing distinct expertise — product management discipline and rigor on one side, content and franchise knowledge on the other. While both positions interface with customers and solicit their feedback, voice-of-customer research represents a larger proportion of the Senior Product Manager’s time.

### **Essential Functions**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Define product vision and strategy for each assigned problem, in partnership with the relevant Franchise Owner(s) and CPO, grounded in customer-centric design, market analysis, competitive dynamics, revenue analysis, and customer research.
* Own and prioritize the roadmap for each assigned problem, making the tradeoffs needed to balance customer value, business priorities, and delivery capacity.

* Partner closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy and franchise identity — to align future product direction with content strategy on each assigned problem.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition and requirements of new product

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Us**
============

Medical data exchange is one of the biggest unsolved problems in US healthcare. If you've spent any real time in the healthcare system, you've felt it, and it only gets worse the sicker and older you get. Metriport exists to fix that. We connect to the data sources the healthcare providers of tomorrow need, take raw data that's unusable in its source form, and turn it into relevant intelligence that care teams, and their agents, actually use to improve outcomes. Record retrieval across thousands of legacy systems and antiquated data pipes that used to take weeks now takes seconds. Clinicians walk into appointments with the full patient picture already in hand, and that speed can mean spotting a condition early enough to actually treat it.

We're not a healthcare company. We're a technology company that happens to operate in healthcare, and we build every layer ourselves: connect, transform, and insight. Legacy EHRs were built to get providers paid, not to serve the clinical experience. We're building what should have existed instead: the system of record for all of US healthcare. We started in data exchange. Today we compete with the largest data platforms in the space. Tomorrow we will be the infrastructure layer healthcare runs on.

We’ve raised $28.4 million from top tier VCs (including Matrix, ARTIS and Y Combinator), found product market fit ($XXM ARR, 150+ customers including Amazon One Medical, Color Health, and Strive Health), and have years of runway ahead of us. If you’ve had a good healthcare experience in the past few years, there’s a good chance Metriport was behind it. That’s the version of healthcare we want people to not just expect, but demand. Join us and build the future.

**About You + The Role**
------------------------

Our task is to read things that are not yet on the page.

As a Staff Technical Product Manager, you’ll be titrating input from a variety of stakeholders into requirements for the next products we’ll be shipping and ultimately be responsible for the successful end to end delivery of those products.

TL;DR: you’ll be the decision maker for what we’ll be building next in your lane of the product.

In practice, this breaks down to 4 main activities:

* Collecting, and responding to, input from internal and external stakeholders.
* Deciding on what to work on next, and communicating that to the team through PODs, PRDs, and an iterated roadmap.
* Executing what we decided to work on from 0 to 1, and seeing things through to successful customer rollout and ongoing monitoring.
* Making sure everyone is a product expert, you’ll be responsible that everyone internal and external to Metriport understands how the product works and how it can bring them value in depth.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Located in Bay Area, or willing to relocate.
* Early stage B2B startup experience at least one company between Seed to Series B that had live customers for at least 2 years where you were responsible for making product bets & shot calling.
* 10+ years of experience as a (Technical) Product Manager for deeply technical infrastructure / analytics products.
* Experience going from ideation to User/Factory Acceptance Testing and successful delivery of new products/features while communicating with enterprise customer stakeholders.
* Bonus points:

  + Thorough understanding of healthcare data, including but not limited to:

    - Standards: HL7v2, FHIR, CDA, DICOM, LOINC, ICD 10, etc
    - Business: Payers, Providers, ACOs, MSOs, etc
    - Health information exchange: IHE, TEFCA, IAS, etc

* Healthy lunches complimentary when in office (and breakfast + dinners as needed)
