jobs.desc:
**About Lively**

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

#### **THE ROLE**

Lively is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how data moves between our platform and the systems our customers and partners rely on — payroll and HR platforms, benefits administration systems, carriers, and third-party administrators. You will own enrollment and eligibility data, file-based and API-based exchange, and the integration roadmap that connects Lively to its ecosystem.

You will also own the AI agent experiences that sit on top of that data layer, with a focus on onboarding and validation: agents that help customers and partners get their data into Lively correctly the first time, interpret what arrives, surface problems in plain language, and propose corrections. Integration work at Lively is increasingly AI-assisted, and this role decides where that assistance belongs and where human review stays mandatory.

Alongside this, you will shape Lively's forward data integration strategy: how our connectivity model evolves as the ecosystem moves toward real-time exchange, where we invest in building versus partnering, and how we make each additional integration cheaper and faster than the last.

This is a technically grounded product role. You will work closely with engineering on system behavior, data design, and agent behavior, and you will be the person partners and internal teams come to when they need to understand how the data actually flows. You will own large initiatives end-to-end and operate as the primary subject matter expert for your areas.

**Please note:** As a majority of our engineering team sits in Pacific time, candidate preference will be given to those in the **Pacific** and **Mountain** timezones.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Responsibilities are listed in order of anticipated time investment:

* Integration Ownership — Own the data exchanged between Lively and its partners: what moves, in what form, on what cadence, and what happens when something goes wrong. Define the contracts that both sides build against.
* AI-Assisted Data Onboarding & Validation — Own the AI agent experiences that accelerate getting partner and customer data into Lively: interpreting unfamiliar file structures, mapping fields, catching errors before they propagate, explaining what went wrong in language a non-technical administrator can act on, and recommending fixes. Define where the agent acts, where it advises, and where a human must approve.
* Enrollment & Eligibility Data — Own the enrollment data lifecycle end to end, including how changes, corrections, and exceptions are handled, and how Lively proves its records match the partner's.
* Reliability, Data Quality & Scale — Own the non-functional requirements of Lively's data integration platform: throughput, latency, availability, recovery, and the guarantee that data is never silently lost or partially applied. Define how failures are detected, communicated, and resolved. Plan capacity for the benefits industry's seasonal enrollment peaks and for growth in partner and record volume. Set the accuracy bar AI-assisted validation must clear before production use.

jobs.desc:
At BOLD, our mission is to transform the lives of job seekers globally through trusted brands like Monster, MyPerfectResume, and FlexJobs. As a Senior Product Manager on our Jobs pillar, you will drive this mission forward by owning **ExpertApply**—our AI-powered job search automation product.

You will own the end-to-end product strategy, driving day-to-day improvements, rigorous experimentation, and revenue-driving growth initiatives. If you are passionate about leveraging AI to build best-in-class consumer tools and thrive in an autonomous, data-driven environment, this is the role for you.

### **About This Team**

The Jobs team builds products to help job seekers find their perfect job, especially when it comes to remote work, WFH and flexible jobs. Our mission is to provide best-in-class tools that drive the best outcomes for our customers and long-term value for our brand. This role is specifically for our ExpertApply product. ExpertApply is our AI-powered job search automation product which applies to relevant job openings based on a candidate's profile.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategic Ownership:** Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap for ExpertApply, partnering with leadership, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to achieve core business goals.
* **Mobile-First Growth:** Champion a mobile-first strategy to optimize the application funnel, drive adoption and retention, and ultimately spearhead the launch of our dedicated mobile app.
* **Growth Loops & Experimentation:** Design, run, and interpret rigorous A/B tests across the product and marketing channels—including collaborating with Email Marketing to leverage job alerts for user retention.
* **Customer-Centric Innovation:** Continuously push the product forward by synthesizing market trends, competitive analysis, quantitative metrics, and qualitative user research into actionable features.

### **What You'll Need**

* **Experience:** 6-10 years of consumer-facing Product Management experience.
* **Execution & Prioritization:** Exceptional attention to detail with the proven ability to seamlessly manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Deep expertise in A/B test design, quantitative metric analysis, and translating complex data sets into clear, actionable business strategies.
* **Technical Fluency:** A solid understanding of modern technology stacks, allowing you to accurately gauge the level of effort and partner effectively with engineering teams.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** A history of cross-functional team building, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a globally distributed, remote work environment.

### **What's Good to Have**

* Experience in B2C subscriptions, Job Boards, or AI-driven products.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.desc:
About Stepful :

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.

  • Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.

  • Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.

  • Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.

  • Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.

##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

##### **Who are we looking for?**

**Skills & Abilities**

* You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
* You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.
* You treat the program's problems as your own. You move

jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
**You'll own a product domain end to end:** its outcomes, its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. You'll work in a trio with a designer and engineering, from discovery through launch and long-term growth.
  
This is not a backlog-grooming role. You'll be handed a business problem and held accountable for what moved, including what you chose not to build.
  
  
**Where it will sit:**  
**One idea runs through every domain:** operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day. Features earn that trust, and trust shows up as revenue. Your job is to find the changes that strengthen it and prove they did.
  
The domains you own will depend on where the business needs you and where your strengths fit. The outcomes below are illustrative. We'll set specific ones with you in your first weeks.
  
Core Ticketing. The fundamental building blocks operators use to turn their experiences into sellable products: single-use, multi-use and reloadable tickets; recurring products like memberships and donations; auto-renewing passes; timed, multi-date and multi-pack admissions; assigned seating; bundles and cross-sells. It also covers how those products are priced, from discounts and upsells to dynamic, usage-based and channel-specific pricing. For operators, this is how new products come to life, capturing more demand and maximizing the revenue of every sale. You'd answer for how quickly operators can launch new products and how much revenue each sale captures.
  
**Distribution. How operators' products get sold:** white-label ecommerce for each operator, RocketRez point of sale at the front gate, OTAs, and third-party sales partners. The work is building systems that make it as easy as possible for a guest to discover what an operator offers, find the best product for them, and complete the sale as quickly as possible. You'd answer for conversion by channel, attach rate, and throughput on peak days.
  
Ancillary Revenue. Revenue beyond admission, like food and beverage and retail, including the build-vs-partner calls that decide how we enter each line. You'd answer for ancillary revenue per guest, and for deals won because we can serve a broader range of operators.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut, even when the CEO or a major customer is asking for it. Engineering is a shared pool, not a dedicated squad, so make an evidence-backed case for your domain's claim on capacity and show that it paid off.
  

* Know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing, and shape pricing and packaging, not just scope.

Discovery, delivery and measurement• Spend real time with operators, like a zoo on a holiday weekend or a tour operator selling through OTAs. Tell a truly painful workflow from a merely unfamiliar one.
  

* Define success before you build, including instrumentation that doesn't exist yet. Measure behaviour change, not adoption.
* Write requirements engineering can estimate against, in plain language.
* Be willing to conclude that a thesis is wrong, and say so plainly.

As a Senior PM, you'll• Raise the decision quality of other PMs through review, pairing and mentoring, and contribute to hiring.
  

* Be the escalation point for cross-domain conflict, not the escalator.

**Two ways to be great here:**  
We hire PMs who lean toward one of two archetypes. Tell us which one sounds like you.
  
Commercial. You think in markets, channels, pricing, and growth. You're at home with sales and partners, you can read a funnel, and you connect product decision

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, People Product
jobs.desc:
**About the team**
------------------

The People Product team builds the internal tools and frameworks that power every employee's journey across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. We combine a hybrid "build + buy" approach to deliver intelligent, scalable and people-centric experiences across hiring, compensation, onboarding, learning, performance and more — connecting our mission to empower local economies with the experience of the people who make it happen. We partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, People/HR, Total Rewards and Talent Acquisition to build products that elevate the entire People Tech stack across all three brands.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the our internal compensation products — this includes the tooling, data, and AI that determine how DoorDash sets and maintains pay ranges across every job family, level, and country.

Range setting is the starting point, as it is the core process of a compensation team and the infrastructure everything else is built on. Your role is to turn that into a product: a range-setting workspace that ingests market and internal data to enable a Compensation Partner to review and make decisions.

This is an individual contributor role with a clearly scoped product area. The range-setting tool and the monitoring dashboard are the anchor. You will also own the seams into adjacent compensation surfaces — recruiter offer guidance, budget modeling, headcount planning, and Workday range loads — wherever they depend on range data.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own product decisions for the compensation range-setting stack — the range tool, its recommendation engine, and the monitoring dashboard — partnering with Compensation on methodology while owning how that methodology becomes product logic.
* Define the data pipelines and data products that range setting depends on — historical ranges, offers, incumbent, and attrition data — and own the partnership with People Analytics on the semantic layer and the proposed compensation data mart, including what the product requires of each.
* Own the range-setting product and analytics roadmap end to end and carry launches to market — adoption, enablement, and change management.
* Improve Compensation Partner productivity across the range review, while also managing intake, prioritization, and requirements definition for this part of the compensation stack.
* Own the seams into adjacent compensation products — recruiter offer guidance, budget modeling, headcount planning, and Workday range loads.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5+ years of product management experience shipping products end to end, including at least one data- or workflow-heavy internal or B2B product.
* Demonstrated success turning a manual, judgment-heavy operational process into a product — rules, guardrails, recommendations, and measurable throughput gains — rather than digitizing a spreadsheet.
* Strong analytical skills and real comfort in data: you can size the problem, define the evaluation metric for a recommendation engine, read a precision-and-recall trade-off without flinching, and tell the difference between an anomaly and a statistically meaningful signal.
* Experience shipping an AI- or model-assisted feature where output quality is the product: rule or prompt design, evaluation sets, and honest measurement against human decisions.
* Excellent partnership and communication skills, including with the partners whose day-to-day judgment your product is encoding. You will need their trust to get their reasoning on the record.
* Experience working across custom-built tools and third-party SaaS (HRIS, ATS, survey and benchmarking, BI), including integrating data across systems and negotiating dependencies with platform and analytics teams.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Direct experience with Compensation or Total Rewards — range architecture, market pricing, survey d

Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**About the Company**

Fanatics Collectibles is the global home for trading cards, sports memorabilia, and digital collectibles, bringing fans closer to the sports moments they love through Topps, Fanatics Live, and Fanatics Collect. As we scale across three platforms, promotions, orchestration, and loyalty are core levers for acquiring new collectors, driving engagement, and bringing back lapsed ones.

  

**Role Summary**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our promotional and loyalty roadmap — the capabilities that let us drive engagement by rewarding the right behavior, at the right moment, for the right collector. This person will drive the strategy and build-out of our promotional and referral capabilities, and how we orchestrate them into cohesive lifecycle campaigns across Topps, Live, and Collect. * Own the product roadmap for promotional capabilities across Topps, Live, and Collect, including how offers, credits, and rewards are created, targeted, and fulfilled
* Drive the roadmap for campaign orchestration, ensuring lifecycle and marketing teams can build and launch targeted, well-timed campaigns that drive engagement across the collector lifecycle
* Own the referral experience, from strategy through execution and optimization
* Define and evolve our broader loyalty strategy, including how promotions, rewards, and referrals fit together to deepen engagement across the collector experience
* Partner closely with Lifecycle to translate campaign and retention goals into product requirements, and with Acquisition to ensure promotional mechanics support growth and conversion goals
* Partner with Engineering to determine the right technical approach for each capability, balancing internal platform investment against third-party tools
* Partner with our central platform organization to ensure their roadmap and capabilities stay aligned with the growth needs of our business
* Build in the guardrails these capabilities need in practice — targeting precision, budget management, fraud and abuse prevention, and compliance considerations
* Define success metrics for promotional and loyalty programs and use them to guide prioritization
* Act as a cross-functional leader, aligning stakeholders across marketing, engineering, finance, and other teams without formal authority

#### **Scope & Impact**

* Owns promotional, orchestration, referral, and loyalty strategy across all three platforms
* Directly influences acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation outcomes
* Serves as the primary product voice for lifecycle

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division - the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants.

As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole.

Gracenote's identifiers and normalized metadata have powered content identification, search, and discovery across the media ecosystem for decades. We are now extending that structured foundation from the title level down to the scene, chapter, and clip level, using multimodal AI to derive rich, queryable understanding directly from video.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to support this team and own go-to-market for the portfolio end to end: the portfolio narrative, the segment-level positioning, the launches, the enablement, and the market intelligence that shapes how we go to market. This is a build-it role, not a maintain-it role. You will help shape a market while it is still forming, and most of what exists twelve months from now will be work you created.

Positioning, narrative, and messaging

* Category definition. Author the market narrative for scene-level video intelligence: the problem, why now, why a shared platform beats point solutions, and why Gracenote is uniquely positioned to provide it.
* Segment-level value propositions. Translate one platform story into distinct, credible propositions for platform and distribution buyers, content owners, and the advertising ecosystem, each with its own economics, buying committee, and proof points.
* Messaging architecture. Build and maintain the messaging house, proof-point library, and terminology standards, and hold the organization to consistent language across product, sales, partnerships, and corporate marketing.

Market, customer, and competitive intelligence

* Competitive program. Maintain a living view of AI video-understanding vendors, platform-native capabilities, and adjacent metadata and ad-tech players. Frame the platform-versus-toolkit distinction in terms buyers actually feel: time to value, integration cost, and cost of ownership at full catalog scale.
* Voice of the customer. Run a structured discovery cadence with prospects, design partners, and internal commercial teams. Convert conversations into documented segment insight rather than anecdote.
* Market requirements. Feed evidence-based requirements and prioritization input to product, and co-author market requirements documents that connect capability to demand.

Launch and lifecycle

* Launch ownership. Own launch strategy and execution across the portfolio: tiering, readiness criteria, cross-functional plans, internal and external timing, and post-launch measurement.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Foundation Engineering
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap for the Observability and Compute/Network teams within Addepar's Foundation Engineering organization. This is a foundational infrastructure role: you'll define and drive the roadmap for how engineers understand the health of their systems (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting, on-call tooling, SLOs) and for the compute and networking substrate their services run on (provisioning, container orchestration, networking, security posture, capacity planning, and cost).

You'll work closely with the rest of the Foundation Engineering group to translate reliability risk, infrastructure constraints, and platform strategy into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap. This role reports to product leadership within Developer Platform and partners day to day with engineering leadership for Observability and Compute/Network.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Own and evolve the product roadmap for the Observability and Compute/Network teams, spanning metrics/logging/tracing platforms, alerting and on-call tooling, SLO and error-budget frameworks, dashboards, compute provisioning, container orchestration, networking, service mesh, capacity planning, and infrastructure cost management.
* Partner with engineering leads across Foundation Engineering to balance reliability and security risks, developer needs, capacity constraints, and cost, translating those tradeoffs into clearly scoped and sequenced investments.
* Define and track outcomes across reliability, performance, developer experience, and cost—for example, SLO attainment, time to detect and restore service, self-service adoption, provisioning lead time, and infrastructure cost per unit—and use them to prioritize investment.
* Drive the self-service agenda: make instrumentation, dashboards, and compute/network provisioning available through paved paths that are secure and policy-compliant by default, so teams get visibility and capacity without manual tickets or one-off configurations.
* Partner with the Information Security and Risk (ISR) team to translate security requirements and risk findings into roadmap priorities, including secure defaults, access controls, auditability, and risk-based vulnerability remediation across observability and compute/network platforms.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from engineering teams across the organization (via incident retrospectives, on-call surveys, and direct engagement) to identify visibility and infrastructure gaps and translate them into roadmap priorities.
* Represent the Observability and Compute/Network teams' roadmaps to platform leadership, product stakeholders, and cross-functional partners; communicate tradeoffs, sequencing, and progress clearly.
* Monitor industry trends in observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog) and compute/network infrastructure (Kubernetes, service mesh, cloud networking, cost optimization) to inform build-vs-buy

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Internal Tools
jobs.desc:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone.

**We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.**

**About the Role**
==================

We're hiring a Product Manager (Technical) to be our product’s right hand as Osmo scales its Software and AI organization. This is a hands-on product role, not a program management role — you'll own scoping, requirements, and delivery negotiation directly, working independently from day one.

Your first mandate: Osmo's internal workflows are largely manual today, and information doesn't always flow through our systems the way it should. You'll identify the 3-5 tools that would drive 80% of the impact, embed with the relevant teams to master the problem, and come out with clear requirements that get built. From there, expect to move across workstreams as priorities shift, applying the same structural skills to a new domain. You'll work closely with engineering throughout, and you'll need to hold your own there: when an estimate doesn't add up, you push back with specifics, ask for the breakdown, and know how to simplify a requirement to get something shipped faster. This role takes real tenacity to drive scope and delivery under ambiguity, and real kindness in how you ask a stretched engineering team for more.

**What You'll Do:**
===================

* **Scope With Rigor** — Independently scope projects end to end: understand the business value and customer need, then write clear, complete requirements that inform what engineering builds.
* **Negotiate Scope and Estimates** — When an engineering estimate doesn't match reality, push back with tenacity: ask for the breakdown, identify what's actually driving the cost, and simplify or revise the requirement to get to a faster, leaner build.
* **Find the 80%** — Scope Osmo's highest-value internal tooling opportunities: identify the 3-5 tools that would drive the majority of workflow impact, then sequence and prioritize the build.
* **Embed and Master** — Rapidly insert yourself into a workstream, understand it deeply, and come out with the requirements and plan to fix what's broken.
* **Partner Directly With Engineering** — Work hand-in-hand with the CTO’s team to get scoped work built and delivered against committed dates.
* **Operate Without a Script** — Take high-level direction into an ambiguous space and bring back clarity, milestones, and a plan — with the curiosity to figure out what's actually needed rather than waiting to be told.
* **Bring Structure Without Bureaucracy** — Sequence and manage ambiguous initiatives without adding process for its own sake.
* **Pivot With the Business** — Move fluidly across workstreams as Osmo's priorities shift, applying the same core PM skill set to new problems.
* **Use AI as a Working Tool** — Build and use AI-powered tools and workflows in your own work — for requirements drafting, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication.

jobs.desc:
**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Every lead sent to our premium customers is vetted and live-transferred to an agent through our Concierge Call Center, and which agent gets that lead is decided by a matching model that increasingly encodes customer-specific business rules, for example price-point eligibility or agent tier restrictions.

This role owns that matching model and everything downstream of it: the agent handoff experience, and the smaller product issues premium customers currently experience as bugs in that flow. You'll have a dedicated engineering team building this with you, and you'll work closely with the teams that own the customer-facing applications where these rules surface.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The matching model: which agent receives a vetted lead, including customer-configurable eligibility and preference rules (e.g. price-point-based agent restrictions) that surface in customer-facing applications.
* Answer-to-Claim and the agent handoff experience: the flow from a vetted lead to a claimed, worked lead.
* Smaller improvements: fixes and refinements to issues premium customers currently perceive as bugs in the handoff experience.
* Claim Rate and Assignment Rate: the two funnel metrics that roll up, together with the Call Center Platform PM's metrics, into overall Live Transfer Rate.

**What you won't own today**
----------------------------

Call-center infrastructure sits with the Call Center Platform PM today. As the two roles mature this scope could expand to include call-center infrastructure.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap for the matching mechanism in close collaboration with the customer experience teams, prioritized against Claim Rate and Assignment Rate impact
* Partner with engineering to turn customer-specific eligibility and preference rules into scalable configuration, not one-off logic per customer.
* Work with the teams owning customer-facing applications to ship the surfaces where customers set or see their matching rules.
* Triage and prioritize the smaller features premium customers experience as bugs in the handoff flow, and decide what's a quick fix versus a roadmap item.
* Track and report on Claim Rate and Assignment Rate, and how they roll up into overall Live Transfer Rate.
* Coordinate with the Call Center Platform PM to keep the boundary between matching logic and call-center execution clean, and help redraw that boundary if the role's scope expands.
* Represent this domain in planning, prioritization, and leadership reviews.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience with a track record of owning complex business logic or decisioning systems, not just user-facing features.
* Experience working in marketplaces or lead-gen models where allocation, matching, or eligibility rules directly affect revenue.
* Comfort translating customer-facing configuration needs (pricing tiers, eligibility rules) into product and engineering requirements.
* A track record of driving measurable funnel metrics (conversion, claim, assignment, or similar) rather than shipping features and hoping they help.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills. You'll coordinate closel

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

  
  

**The Role**

  

The Content Promotion & Distribution team is responsible for designing the suite of products that power a show’s journey from ingestion to streaming. We build products to help Netflix and our partners plan, ingest, decorate, launch, and promote the best content to our members at a global scale. From artwork to collections, synopses to ratings, the team shapes much of what members see and feel, powering a nuanced promotion and discovery engine that leaves every member feeling that Netflix was crafted just for them.

  
  

We leverage vast data sets and cutting-edge AI technology to improve operational workflows, scale our catalog capabilities, and distribute at speed. We design products that bring insights and intelligence to creatives’ fingertips, enhancing their ability to make the best possible content and consumer member experiences. We own the global catalog, foundational elements that take raw media and decorate it with metadata, artwork, trailers, synopses, subs, dubs - our technology fuels one of the world’s most powerful entertainment platforms, ensuring that great stories can come from anywhere and be loved everywhere.

  
  

The Product Manager for Scaled Content Systems will partner with Engineering, Operations, and Design to build and scale the platforms, services, and tools powering the content lifecycle—while resisting the temptation to treat every new deal as a bespoke one-off. This is a pivotal moment for the business. You will play a key role in shaping this evolution. Just as importantly, you will be a close product partner to the domain teams who run these workflows, turning their hardest problems into a durable product strategy.

We have launched the first suite of products, but we are far from done. This is a high-leverage role with direct impact on the speed, quality, and cost with which content reaches members around the world.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Owner (PO) owns the vision, backlog, and delivery outcomes for one or more of Roeing’s public-sector software products. The Senior PO translates state and federal program requirements into a prioritized backlog, represents Roeing’s voice to the customer and the customer’s voice to internal delivery teams, and is accountable for maximizing product value across the full software development lifecycle. This is a senior individual-contributor role expected to operate with minimal oversight, mentor Business Analysts and Product Owners, and serve as the escalation point for backlog, prioritization, and requirements decisions on assigned product(s).

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Vision, Strategy & Regulatory Ownership

* Define and communicate the product vision and roadmap, aligned to Roeing’s strategic objectives and the governing state/federal program guidelines for the assigned agency contract.
* Serve as the regulatory subject-matter expert, tracking compliance and reporting/data-transparency obligations that shape the roadmap, and driving continuous improvement to keep pace with them.

**Product Backlog Management**

* Own, create, refine, and prioritize the product backlog independently, writing clear epics, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria, sequenced by value, risk, dependency, and urgency.
* Plan product releases — scope, schedule, and goals — and forecast delivery dates and outcomes in partnership with the assigned PM.

**Stakeholder & Client Collaboration**

* Act as the primary liaison between state-agency stakeholders, customers, and Roeing’s development, QA, and architecture teams.

**Product Value, Market & Client-Facing Duties**

* Maximize product value by ensuring releases meet customer-satisfaction and business-goal targets, iterating on ticket-metrics and user feedback.
* Represent Roeing at trade associations, tradeshows, or user-group meetings, and partner with the Account Executive on demos, RFP/SOW input, and quarterly user training.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (equivalent experience considered).
* 5+ years in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Product Management, including 2+ years at a senior/lead level of independence.

jobs.desc:
#### **Job Description**

We’re hiring a dedicated product manager to own B2C ecommerce, conversion rate optimization and payments. You’ll shape our custom commerce platform and prioritize improvements to the business throughout the transition.

You’ll work directly with our head of tech, engineers, data engineer, finance, marketing and showroom operations.

#### **Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Product roadmap: prioritize customer and business problems across discovery, ring configuration, appointments, cart, checkout and payments
* Customer insight: combine customer conversations, showroom feedback, support issues and behavioral data to identify friction
* CRO: develop hypotheses, select appropriate experiments and make rollout decisions from measured results
* Full-funnel measurement: connect website behavior to online purchases, appointment bookings, attendance and subsequent showroom sales
* Payments experience: improve payment completion, deposits, balance payments, refunds and recovery from failed payments
* Provider evaluation: assess payment and financing options with finance, including cost, approval rates, fraud and operational effort
* Delivery: write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, resolve scope decisions and coordinate business acceptance testing
* Migration readiness: define essential launch capabilities, sequence releases and coordinate staff readiness with operations

#### **Requirements and Experience:**

* B2C product ownership: a record of owning an ecommerce product or a substantial purchase funnel
* CRO results: measurable improvements in conversion or purchase completion, with a clear explanation of how you assessed the result
* Payments experience: direct work with checkout, payment providers, authorization rates, refunds or chargebacks
* Analytical judgment: ability to define reliable metrics, interpret experiments and work with a data engineer to validate measurement
* Commercial understanding: ability to assess conversion gains alongside margin, payment costs, cancellations and support burden
* Technical fluency: comfort discussing APIs, integrations, data dependencies and release tradeoffs with engineers
* Delivery ownership: ability to make prioritization decisions and stay involved through launch, measurement and iteration
* High-consideration retail: jewelry, luxury, configurable products or other purchases involving a longer decision process
* Connected channels: customer journeys spanning ecommerce and physical locations
* Commerce migrations: replacing a live platform while maintaining day-to-day trading

Success in this role means more completed, profitable purchases across online and showroom channels, improved payment completion and a roadmap focused on the highest-value customer problems.

#### **Job Details:**

* Schedule: We work Eastern Time US hours.
* Salary: $145,000-$180,000 based on experience

#### **Benefits:**

* **Equity Compensation.** Every Frank Darling team member receives a stock option package to share in the company's upside.
* **Insurance.** Medical, dental, and vision insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month!
* **401k.** Optional 401k program.
* **Paid Time Off.** Flexible, unlimited paid time off policy enables motivated, goal-oriented team members to recharge
* **Disability and Life Insurance.**
* **Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits.**
* **Employee Discounts.** A generous discount program for you, your friends, and your family to make it easy to wear and gift Frank Darling.

jobs.desc:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
-------------------------

We're on a mission to help communities adapt to a changing world. Forerunner builds modern, easy-to-use software for the people who keep communities running. Local governments, federal agencies, and infrastructure operators use Forerunner to run inspections, enforce codes, manage public works, respond to disasters, and meet their regulatory obligations.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead product for the Field Intelligence team.

You’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forerunner helps field teams understand what needs attention, capture trustworthy information, and turn their findings into action. This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

This is a high-ownership role for a hands-on product builder who enjoys getting close to users, making sense of complicated operational environments, and turning that understanding into clear product direction and tangible solutions. Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, while partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure what we build is adopted and creates measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Field Intelligence, from work planning and data capture through review, follow-up, and resolution.
* Spend time with inspectors, field crews, program managers, and operational leaders to understand how work happens in practice.
* Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to improve fieldwork while preserving user control, transparency, and trust.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, define requirements, and ship polished end-to-end experiences across mobile and web.
* Define how we measure success, including adoption, task completion, data quality, time saved, issue-resolution time, and customer outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, pilots, usage data, and structured experimentation.
* Balance immediate customer needs with investments in shared platform capabilities, reliability, and long-term product differentiation.
* Develop thoughtful rollout and change-management plans for workflows used in regulated and operationally critical environments.
* Equip Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing with a clear product narrative, launch materials, demonstrations, and the context needed to support adoption.
* Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and learnings clearly across the company.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of a complex product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Excellent product judgment. You can separate urgent requests from durable needs, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and turn ambiguous problems into focused product bets.
* A builder’s mindset. You don’t stop at setting direction or managing delivery. You use prototypes, data, workflow models, technical exploration, and other hands-on methods to learn quickly and help the team arrive at a better product.
* Experience shipping AI-powered product experiences to real users. You understand what it takes to make them trustworthy in production, including evaluation, failure modes, guardrails, and iteration based on real-world behavior.
* Strong customer instincts and experience learning from users whose work is operational

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Identity Products
jobs.desc:
**Why Socure?**
---------------

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**Senior Product Manager, Identity Products**
=============================================

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to build and take to market a new category of products at Socure: proactive identity notifications. These are subscription products that continuously monitor identities on our customers' behalf and push an alert when something material about that identity changes.

This is a zero-to-one role with a near-term launch. You will own the first product in this line end to end: defining what good looks like, closing any performance gaps that stand between us and a product customers will pay for, shaping the event contract and subscription model, and running it from beta through GA. More event types will follow close behind, and the scope will continue to expand as the portfolio grows.

Data is the heart of this role. The quality of a proactive notification product is the quality of the data underneath it: how much of the real world it sees, how accurate it is, and how quickly it knows. You will own that. You will establish the performance metrics that define success, decide what we need to source and what a candidate source has to prove, and make the call on which sources have earned their place and which have not. A dedicated Data Partnerships team runs discovery, negotiation, licensing, and vendor management against the brief you set, alongside data science and engineering.

You will also own commercialization. Pricing and packaging, commercial terms, early-adopter recruitment, beta and GA phasing, enablement, and coordinating every function to a launch date all sit with you.

This is a highly technical and highly commercial role. It suits a PM who is equally comfortable arguing about precision and recall methodology with a data scientist in the morning and defending a pricing model to the executive team in the afternoon.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Product definition and launch**

* Own the roadmap, definition, and launch of proactive identity notification products, from first beta customer through general availability.
* Define the customer-facing event contract: what the notification contains, its lifecycle semantics, and how customers consume and act on it.
* Design a systematic customer feedback loop so every notification we send makes the next one better.
* Begin the product definition for the next event types on the roadmap, where the customer problem is more open-ended and the framing work is still to be done.

### **Data source strategy**

* Own what we source and why: define the gaps in our coverage, specify what a candidate source must prove, and set the bar it has to clear. Data Partnerships runs discovery and commercial negotiation against that brief.
* Run rigorous, hypothesis-driven evaluations that measure incremental lift rather than headline coverage claims, and make the buy, build, or walk-away call.
* Specify the licensing, retention, and derivative-use terms the product needs, and treat them as first-class inputs to every sourcing decision rather than an afterthought. Legal, Data Protection, and Data Partnerships paper the deal.
* Hold the portfolio to its KPIs: decide which sources have earned their cost, which need renegotiating, and which to retir

--------------------

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About MacStadium**  
Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, MacStadium is the leading provider of private Mac cloud infrastructure, purpose-built for the Apple ecosystem. Our mission is to deliver cloud solutions that simplify Mac for business. We give enterprises, software teams, and independent developers dedicated access to genuine Apple hardware, without the overhead of procuring, racking, or managing it themselves, so they can build, test, and ship Apple platform software faster and more securely.  
Our product portfolio spans macOS virtualization and orchestration (Orka), private Mac cloud and bare-metal compute, Mac Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI, including Citrix-based remote desktop access) for distributed teams, and dedicated Apple Silicon infrastructure for AI and machine learning workloads. We're trusted by organizations ranging from fast-growing startups to household names, and leading financial institutions, who rely on MacStadium to power their iOS, macOS, and cross-platform development pipelines at scale.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own and optimize the entire MacStadium user journey, ensuring customers easily discover the value of our Mac ecosystem, mobile development, and emerging technology solutions from first engagement through long-term retention. You'll focus on reducing churn, improving signup-to-meeting-to-purchase conversion, and strengthening the overall product experience by working cross-functionally with product domain experts, marketing, sales, and technical support and customer success.  
As part of both product experience and growth, you'll seed and shape innovation initiatives in areas such as AI, clustering, and automation. You'll also take ownership of where MacStadium focuses its product design projects, ensuring high impact, consistency, and usability across the platform, including the experiences our Orka, Mac VDI/Citrix, and mobile development customers rely on every day.

**What you will be doing**

**Product Experience:**

* Map and optimize the buyer and user journey, from first awareness to adoption, purchase, and retention, across MacStadium's Mac ecosystem and mobile development products.
* Identify friction points in product discovery and usability, ensuring customers can quickly see how MacStadium's Mac infrastructure, virtualization, and mobile CI/CD offerings solve their needs.
* Collaborate with marketing and sales to develop a strategic framework for product design that supports seamless continuity throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Growth and Retention:**

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Compute Platform - Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix's Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering provides a secure, scalable foundation that accelerates the productivity and innovation of Netflix technology teams by abstracting infrastructure complexity behind a managed platform. Compute sits at the center of that foundation: every service, batch job, training run, inference request, and agent at Netflix ultimately runs on the compute platform we build.

  
  

Our Compute platform runs many kinds of workloads at a massive scale. That includes stateless and stateful services, batch jobs, streaming, media encoding, and a growing amount of distributed training and inference across our GPU fleet. Agentic workloads are now part of that mix. They introduce a new set of platform needs. Identity, sandboxed execution, observability, and cost accountability all need to be built in from the start.

  
  

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager with broad knowledge of distributed systems and infrastructure, strong systems thinking, and the ability to work with engineers at architectural depth. You’ll lead the modernization of Netflix’s Compute Platform as AI becomes a larger part of what we build. The goal is a common platform where services, batch jobs, training, inference, and agents can run securely, reliably, and efficiently at Netflix scale. You’ll own product direction and execution across the Compute portfolio, making the tradeoffs required to evolve our infrastructure, support new workload patterns, use capacity effectively, and meet specialized needs across Studio, Ads, and Games. You’ll turn deep technical context into a coherent strategy, sound product decisions, and meaningful results across the business. You’ll have the autonomy to make those decisions and the accountability that comes with them.

  
  

What You Will Do

* Set the strategic direction for Netflix’s Compute platforms in an agent-first world. You’ll define how our platform evolves to support this future, including guiding the move from Titus to a modern Kubernetes stack and weighing migration costs against the value of a common platform. At Netflix scale, this evolution is as much a product challenge as an engineering one.

* Improve how we manage GPU capacity. You’ll own the roadmap for provisioning, scheduling across regions, and fleet utilization. The goal is to give training and inference workloads the capacity they need within seconds while using the fleet efficiently.

* Define how agents run at Netflix. You’ll lead the development of a secure, managed environment that can support millions of agents, with built-in identity, isolation, governance, observability, and cost tracking.

* Make compute easier to use by creating a seamless experience across the full compute spectrum, from VMs to functions. You’ll improve our managed offerings so teams can focus on their work rather than infrastructure details, guided by regular engagement with service owners, ML engineers, and teams building agents.

* Improve efficiency across the fleet to drive hundreds of millions of dollars of impact. You’ll work on defining systems that manage compute supply and demand to ensure efficient resource use and that compute costs grow more slowly than demand. You’ll also establish clear measures for adoption, utilization, cost per workload, and reliability.

* Partner with teams across Ads, Live, Games, and Studio to ensure our compute platform supports their most demanding wor

jobs.desc:
#### **About us**

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**

Understanding cyber risk at internet scale is a difficult product problem. The data must be broad enough to identify meaningful exposures, accurate enough to support important decisions, and timely enough to be useful when it matters. It also needs to be presented in ways that different users can understand and act on.

As Product Manager, Scanning & Risk Data, you will bring a product perspective to this challenge. You will connect the technical systems that collect and process security data with the people and products that use it. You will set priorities, clarify trade-offs, and help Coalition build a more accurate, scalable, and actionable view of cyber risk.

#### **What You'll Own**

* The product strategy for Coalition's scanning and risk-data capabilities.
* How we discover and understand a company's digital assets, technologies, vulnerabilities, and security posture.
* The quality, accuracy, timeliness, and usability of the data produced by our scanning systems.
* The experiences, APIs, and data products that make risk information useful to underwriters, security teams, analysts, and customers.
* The balance between coverage, precision, speed, reliability, and cost as the platform scales.
* The roadmap for improving our ability to add new signals, support new use cases, and deliver consistent value across Coalition's products.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Develop a clear product vision for how Coalition collects, interprets, and delivers cyber-risk intelligence.
* Work with Engineering and Data to improve the coverage, accuracy, performance, and reliability of our scanning capabilities.
* Partner with Underwriting, Actuarial, Security, and customer-facing teams to understand their needs and translate them into products and capabilities.
* Decide which problems to solve first and make thoughtful trade-offs between new functionality and improvements to quality, scale, and reliability.
* Define success metrics and use quantitative and qualitative feedback to guide product decisions.
* Create simple, reusable ways for teams and customers to access and understand risk data.
* Lead product discovery, write requirements, shape solutions with design and engineering, and guide initiatives from concept through launch.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Help the team apply AI and automation thoughtfully.

#### **What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including work on technical, data-intensive, platform, infrastructure, security, or developer-facing products.
* Experience building products that serve multiple users or teams with different needs and priorities and a track record of partnering effectively with Engineering, Data, Design, and business stakeholders.

If you've built products that move money securely and compliantly, you'll find a natural home here, helping funds reach the organizations doing mission-driven work.

**About Fluxx:**  
At Fluxx, our mission is to be the leading collaborative grant management platform in our global communities. We build technology that drives positive impact by helping foundations, government agencies, and nonprofits streamline their grants management process – on both the grantmaking and grantseeking side – helping to accelerate impact across the communities we serve.

Today, Fluxx supports a global community of 500+ customers who collectively manage and distribute more than $39B in grants annually.

**About Fluxx Grantseeker:**

Grantseeker was originally launched by Fluxx in 2017 to help nonprofits manage the grantseeking process—a market traditionally underserved by grants management software. After serving more than 3,000 nonprofits, the platform was strategically divested in 2023, rebuilt as Grantseeker Pro for larger nonprofit and public sector organizations, and re-acquired by Fluxx in November 2025.

**Connect funders and seekers**. Turn Fluxx's two-sided position into a shipped product — data flow, reduced duplicate entry, shared visibility — partnering with the Grantmaker team on shared data models.

**Senior Product Manager**

Location: New York City | In-office

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

**The Opportunity: Turn Clinical Expertise into Product**
=========================================================

As our Senior Product Manager, you’ll bring deep clinical and EHR knowledge into the decisions that shape Taxo. You’ll understand how care teams actually work, identify where automation can help, and turn that insight into products engineers can build and customers can use. This role is for someone who can move comfortably between a clinical workflow, an EHR integration, and a product decision.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Get Close to the Workflow:** Spend time with clinicians, practice teams, and healthcare operators to understand their workflows, bottlenecks, and exceptions.
* **Own Product Decisions:** Own product discovery, roadmap priorities, requirements, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered administrative workflows.
* **Turn Complexity into Clarity:** Translate complex clinical and operational processes into clear product requirements and release plans, with measurable acceptance criteria for engineering and quality teams to validate.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **The Product Builder:** Experience delivering healthcare software from discovery through adoption, with concrete examples of workflow exceptions you addressed, integration tradeoffs you made, and measurable adoption or operational outcomes.
* **The Translator:** The ability to map complex workflows, identify exceptions, and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues.
* **The Systems Thinker:** Practical understanding of EHR capabilities, integration constraints, data quality, and patient privacy, grounded in product decisions you have made.
* **The Decision Maker:** Strong prioritization and analytical skills, with a track record of using customer feedback and product data to make decisions.
* **The Owner:** Comfort working closely with engineers and taking ownership of the details needed to get a product into use.

* **AI with a Clear Purpose:** Focus on where automation can reduce work while preserving reliability and human oversight.

jobs.desc:
**Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI**
=========================================

**REMOTE, United States**
-------------------------

**JOB OVERVIEW**

Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

**Agent definition.** Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it.

**Problem selection.** The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

**The human-in-the-loop contract.** Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

**Build quality.** You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

**Evaluation.** Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

**Specifications.** Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

**Commercialization.** Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

**Design-partner delivery.** Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke.

Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

We are hiring a **Senior Technical Product Manager** for a highly visible, client-facing role. You'll lead the API build and client onboarding and implementation, from technical kickoff through production go-live, and partner with Sales and Pre-Sales to win and launch business.

This is a high-impact role for a hands-on product manager. You'll define and own the technical requirements, including API design, data models, event-driven integrations, and traffic management policies such as rate limiting and throttling. You'll bring the technical depth to shape architecture decisions with specificity, not just business cases. When integrations break, you'll dive deep with engineering to find the root cause and drive the fix.

You'll serve as the technical voice our clients can trust. You'll lead integration design sessions with client architects and technology leaders, turn their requirements into plans your engineering teams can execute, and see those plans through production. You'll write concisely and present complex technical topics with equal clarity to engineers and senior executives.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Write clear, testable product requirements, API specifications (OpenAPI), and acceptance criteria. Drive the SDLC across design, build, test, release, and post-release validation.
* Own and execute client onboarding and implementation end to end, from technical kickoff and integration design through UAT, production readiness, and go-live.
* Serve as the senior technical subject matter expert and point of contact for client engineering, architecture, and security teams. Lead integration design sessions and translate client needs into executable plans.
* Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales as the technical lead on API-led opportunities, including discovery, solution design, live demos, and RFP and security questionnaire responses.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads on platform architecture, service boundaries, and scalability trade-offs. Define and review data models and canonical schemas across APIs, events, and persistence layers.
* Define requirements for event-driven integrations, including Kafka topic and event schema design and webhook payloads, retries, and signing.
* Define API traffic management and access policies, including rate limiting, throttling, quotas, IP whitelisting, and OAuth 2.0 and API key provisioning.
* Own requirements for reference data structures, the reference data engine (RDE), and integrations with document management systems.
* Dive deep with engineering on production issues and client escalations to identify root cause, drive resolution, and keep clients informed.
* Drive execution across large, geographically distributed engineering and QA teams. Establish mechanisms such as release readiness reviews and go/no-go gates, and report on release predictability, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Build a repeatable onboarding playbook and continuously reduce time to go-live by turning recurring integration friction into product requirements and documentation.
* Bring structured client and field feedback to product leadership to inform roadmap priorities.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* 8+ years of technical product management, solutions architecture, or technical implementation experience, including 4+ years on API or platform products
* Experience writing detailed product requirements and owning the SDLC
