* Size new product lines and adjacencies, and work with product leadership to run proofs of concept and decide whether to bring new products to market.
* Shape long-term product and company strategy, turning market, customer, and competitive insight into multi-year plans and investment choices.
* Run the operating cadence for R&D strategy, including planning, business reviews, and executive reporting.
* Hire, build, and lead a team of strategy and operations professionals.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* 2+ years of experience in management consulting or investment banking.
* 5+ years of operating experience in a business operations or corporate strategy role.

* Experience hiring, developing, and leading a team.

TechBootcamp.com is an online career education company. We are starting with the Data Center Accelerator, which helps U.S. tradespeople, veterans and suitable career changers transition into data center roles.

We are hiring a senior Head of Product / Lead Instructor to build the program from the ground up and own its development, delivery and improvement.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**About Bruno**
===============

Bruno is the local-first, Git-native API client trusted by more than 4 million developers worldwide. From startups to Fortune 500 companies, engineering teams use Bruno to build, test, and collaborate on APIs without the complexity, cost, or security concerns of cloud-first tools.

We're building beyond the API client, expanding into API collaboration, documentation, registries, and enterprise developer workflows.

We have a product developers already love, a passionate open-source community, and an ambitious roadmap. We're looking for someone to help define what comes next.

**About the Role**
==================

We're looking for a product leader who is still a builder at heart.

Someone who has strong opinions about what makes a great developer product, understands the technical details behind it, and enjoys working closely with engineers to bring ideas to life.

You'll lead Bruno's product direction, work closely with the founders and engineering leadership, and develop a growing team of Product Managers.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage roadmaps from a distance. We want someone comfortable opening the product, reproducing bugs, talking to developers, challenging assumptions, writing specifications, and getting into the weeds with engineering.

You'll need to balance the needs of our open-source community, individual developers, and enterprise customers while keeping Bruno simple, focused, and enjoyable to use.

We value strong opinions, but we expect them to be challenged. You'll need the judgment to make difficult trade-offs, the curiosity to understand problems firsthand, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into products that actually ship.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own product strategy and roadmap: define where Bruno should go, what we should build, and equally importantly, what we should not build.
* Set a high bar for product quality, developer experience, usability, simplicity, and craftsmanship.
* Lead and develop the PM team: coach Product Managers, improve product thinking, and build a team capable of independently owning meaningful product areas.
* Stay close to developers: regularly engage with users, understand their workflows, and identify problems worth solving.
* Partner deeply with Engineering to work through technical trade-offs, architecture, feasibility, and scope.
* Turn ambiguity into clear product decisions, specifications, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Balance long-term product bets with consistent execution and delivery.
* Use product analytics, customer feedback, market understanding, and judgment to make informed decisions.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand customer needs, support product-led growth, and inform pricing and packaging decisions.
* Work directly with the founders to challenge assumptions, align on priorities, and build a strong product culture.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms.
* Strong technical depth across APIs, Git, networking, developer workflows, and system architecture.
* Exceptional product judgment and a strong instinct for simplicity and developer experience.
* A builder's mindset: you enjoy prototyping, experimenting, and getting hands-on with products.
* A proven track record of taking meaningful products from idea to launch, with measurable results.
* Deep developer empathy and a genuine understanding of how developers work.
* Strong prioritization skills and the conviction to say no to ideas that don't move the product forward.
* Excellent written communication and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems.
* Opinionated but low-ego, comfortable challenging ideas and changing your mind when the evidence warrants it.
* Experience leading and mentoring Product Managers while raising the quality of product thinking.
* Comfortable work

jobs.title: VP of Product, Bucketlisters
jobs.desc:
**About Us**
============

At Bucket Listers, we're all about unleashing life’s full potential and having a blast along the way! Our goal is to encourage people to make lasting memories, forge new connections, and embark on new adventures through our platform of curated experiences. Our vibrant community of explorers relies on us to help them find the coolest events and experiences any day of the week.

We're on a mission to make magic happen, and we're searching for enthusiastic individuals to join our incredible team. We're not just dreamers; we're seasoned explorers ourselves, and we can't wait to share our infectious positivity and limitless inspiration with the world.

### **The Opportunity**

As **Vice President of Product**, you will help shape the future of Bucket Listers' product ecosystem, translating bold ideas into scalable products that enhance how millions of people discover, book, and experience unforgettable events.

This role goes far beyond owning a product roadmap. You will define the strategic direction of our platform, partnering closely with Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and bring innovative solutions to market. You will balance long-term vision with disciplined execution, ensuring our products evolve alongside the needs of our customers, partners, and rapidly growing business.

We're looking for a leader who sees product as a competitive advantage. You'll challenge assumptions, uncover new opportunities, and build the frameworks that allow teams to move quickly, make smarter decisions, and execute with confidence.

We're a remote-first company and open on location, though we'd especially welcome candidates in the greater New York City area who are excited to connect in person and collaborate with leadership live.

The base salary range for this role is $210,000-$240,000. Our ranges are set using competitive market data for companies of our size, stage, and industry. Where a candidate lands within the range depends on their experience and location.

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Define and own Bucket Listers' product vision, strategy, and roadmap, balancing customer needs, technical investment, operational efficiency, and revenue opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver products that drive measurable business impact.
* Measure product performance through KPIs, analytics, and customer insights, continuously optimizing the customer experience and business impact.

In 1984, AT&T put Dynamic Nonhierarchical Routing (DNHR) into the national network, which became the basis of global real-time telephony routing that came after it.

**Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)**

**Job Description:**

Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

**The opportunity:**

* Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
* Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
* Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver SafeSend. Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
* Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy. Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer[CH1]
* Componentize the portfolio. Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
* Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration. Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel. Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.  

**What success looks like:**

* Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
* The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
* Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
* A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
* Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
* Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
* Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-pro

jobs.title: Director of Product Strategy, Commerce
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

We are looking for a **Director of Product Strategy, Commerce** to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

* Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
* Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
* Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM SAM capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
* Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
* Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
* Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

AI Experiences employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own a current, first-principles POV on the agentic-commerce market, the protocol landscape (for example ACP, UCP, AP2, MCP), and where Microsoft’s advantage is real.
* Design and pressure-test monetization: the payer model across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner, the methods, and the sequencing.
* Build the opportunity models and forecasts that let the org rank bets and defend investment asks with numbers, including ARR- and ROI-based justification.
* Bring repeatable decision frameworks to major product bets so the reasoning is structured and legible.
* Synthesize the Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments threads into one coherent strategy and surface where they conflict.
* Turn the analysis into the strategy spine — the MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, and investment cases — and prep the VP with a sharp POV and the two or three things that would change it.
* Operate as a peer to senior leaders: form a POV, defend it, and change it on evidence.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Business Administration or related

Own how Plaud's products are positioned, launched, and proven in market.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role:

As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance.
  • Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses.
  • Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation.
  • Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics 
  • Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis.
  • Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar).
  • Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State).

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:
Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

Designs, develops and manages the lifecycle of a product or group of products from concept to launch to end of life. Translates market opportunities and customer demand into viable products and services that differentiate Equinix in the market. Sets the vision and strategy for their product ensuring it is competitively positioned and customer-centric. Manages the product roadmap including features, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line. Works cross functionally with user experience, engineering, operations, solution architects, marketing and others to design, build and launch new products and/or product features.

Product Lifecycle Management

Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap

Backlog Prioritization

Stakeholder Management

  • Manages stakeholder expectations within and/or across functions

Qualifications

jobs.desc:
Requisition #: 20914
Functional Area: Product Management
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Options: In Office / Partial Remote from Neenah/Appleton/Oshkosh area #LI-Hybrid
Work Hours: Standard Business Hours

Position Summary

Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for innovation and customer-centric solutions? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where your ideas shape the future of technology? Join us as a Product Leader and help drive the success of our Cloud and Training product lines within our Technology Solutions business unit.

As a Product Leader, you'll be responsible for the full lifecycle of your product/service line - from concept launch to ongoing optimization. You'll be at the forefront of designing, launching, and evolving products and services that make a real impact. You'll collaborate across teams, engage with customers, and lead initiatives that fuel growth and deliver exceptional value. We're looking for someone who is a visionary, a builder, and a champion for excellence.

This position is required to work onsite at least 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmapping

    • Define and maintain the product/service vision and roadmap.
    • Analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities for new offerings or enhancements.
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align product strategy with business goals.

Product Development & Lifecycle Management

    • Lead the design and launch of new products/services and features.
    • Manage the lifecycle of existing offerings, including updates and retirements.
    • Own assigned back-office systems that support product functionality and user experience.

Customer & Market Engagement

    • Gather and prioritize customer requirements through direct engagement and market research.
    • Represent the company at industry events to promote offerings and gather insights.
    • Monitor and improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention metrics.

Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Partner with Development teams throughout the product lifecycle, including backlog grooming and prioritization.
    • Work with Marketing and Portfolio Management to develop pricing strategies and go-to-market plans.
    • Collaborate with Sales to ensure offerings are packaged and positioned effectively.

Performance & Financial Accountability

    • Drive revenue growth and meet launch objectives for assigned product lines.
    • Manage budgets and expenses in alignment with departmental and corporate goals.
    • Track and report on key performance indicators, including Customer Loyalty Index results.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years in a product/service design, product/service manager, or project management role, preferably for a commercialized customer-facing offering.
  • Prior experience working with business software applications, preferably including business-to-business websites and back-office systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in writing requirements for business software applications, including business-to-business websites and back-office systems.
  • Prior experience in a leadership role strongly preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required in Marketing, Business or a Technology field.
  • In lieu of degree, may consider an additional 4 years of experience in a product management or project management role.

jobs.title: Logistics Product Manager, MENA
jobs.desc:
Nash in MENA

Nash was born in San Francisco in 2021 by our Founders Mahmoud and Aziz who share deep ties to the region and were classmates together at MIT. Prior to Nash, Aziz led Enterprise Engagements at Palantir and started the tech non-profit Tarjimly. Mahmoud is a third time founder, having successfully exited two previous ventures, including Arsann. Nash has raised venture capital from leading Silicon Valley VCs including Andreessen Horowitz and YCombinator. We are making logistics better across North America, Europe, APAC and now the Middle East too. Join and build the future of the Last Mile with us.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Logistics Product Manager to own and grow some of our most strategic enterprise accounts. This is not a temporary or project-based role—you are the long-term owner of the customer relationship, accountable for adoption, performance, and ongoing outcomes. Acting as an embedded partner, you will work directly with customer product, engineering, and operations teams to design, deploy, and continually optimize solutions on Nash’s platform.

This role sits within our Customer Success organization and blends strategic account leadership with hands-on technical problem solving. You will drive adoption, reduce defects, improve operational performance, and ensure customers realize meaningful business impact. In short: you own the account, the results, and the success of the partnership.

Responsibilities

  • Own enterprise customer accounts end-to-end — act as the single point of accountability for adoption, performance, and growth.

  • Partner closely with customer product and engineering teams to design, deploy, and scale solutions on Nash’s platform.

  • Become a true Nash expert — understand platform capabilities and limitations as well as anyone in the company.

  • Use your expertise to advise customers, guide integrations, and identify improvement opportunities.

  • Drive measurable outcomes across KPIs such as delivery performance, defect reduction, and cost efficiency.

  • Lead account growth and retention by ensuring customers realize ongoing value and by surfacing new expansion opportunities.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration or workflow challenges in collaboration with customer engineers and Nash’s internal teams.

  • Act as the internal advocate for your accounts, ensuring their priorities are represented across cross-functional initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing, technical role such as Technical CSM, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed PM, or similar.

  • Proven success owning enterprise customer relationships and driving adoption, performance, and growth.

  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable with APIs, integrations, debugging workflows, and collaborating with engineering.

  • Experience advising customer product/engineering leaders and translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose root causes in complex systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly master a product and use that knowledge to guide customers and shape feedback.

  • Excellent communication and executive-presence skills.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, ev

SiPhox Health is building the leading home testing platform for biomarkers across inflammation, hormones, and metabolic and cardiovascular health. Six in ten Americans live with a chronic disease, and our mission is to make early detection possible from home.

Offering extensive and essential solutions - including pharmaceutical ingredients and service, mixing technology manufacturing, analytical testing, and education – Medisca is bridging the gaps in healthcare with an unwavering commitment to precision, innovation, and societal impact.


The Upstream Product Manager is responsible for driving the front end of product innovation and strategy, translating market needs into actionable product opportunities and line extensions. This role leads the development of long-term product roadmaps, performs in-depth market and competitive analysis, and partners with cross-functional teams—including R&D, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing—to define requirements for new product development and extensions of existing lines. Acting as the voice of the customer during early-stage product planning. The Upstream Product Manager ensures that product concepts are both market-driven and commercially viable. They manage the entire lifecycle of new product introductions up to launch readiness, owning key deliverables such as business cases, pricing targets, and go-to-market inputs. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, playing a critical role in identifying white space opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and ensuring a steady pipeline of innovation and product evolution that aligns with company goals.


The opportunity:


Product Strategy & Road mapping



  • Owns the 5-year new product roadmap for the portfolio.

  • Develop and manage product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer requirements.

  • Evaluate and prioritize new product opportunities, ensuring feasibility and alignment with Medisca’s strategic objectives.

  • Lead the development and ownership of key strategic planning documents for the portfolio, including the Product Charter, Opportunity

  • Assessment, and Business Case, to define the product’s vision, evaluate market potential, and justify investment decisions.

  • Reviews potential expiring patents for early entrance into the market as a competitor.

  • Complete internal documentation and works with the patent attorney for any innovative ideas that can be patented.

  • Monitor and assess product portfolio for gaps, identifying areas for improvement and driving innovation.

  • Perform market sizing, segmentation, and white space analysis to guide new product development.


Customer & Market Insight (VOC)



  • Analyze product data, voice of customer (VOC) information and market trends to identify and generate new business opportunities, define product requirements, and assess market development opportunities.

  • Engage with customers and industry experts to gather insights and feedback for continuous product improvement.

  • Participate in sales calls and visit customers when needed to gather feedback for new product additions.

  • Identify and attend tradeshows that will help drive innovation, meet new potential partners, and understand industry trends.


Product Development & Requirements



  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales, to define product requirements and drive product development.

Payments is a regulated business. We hold a Major Payment Institution licence

from the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under a spread of local

regimes, scheme rules and partner-bank obligations. Today, most of our risk,

fraud and AML capability exists to keep us safe. We believe a meaningful share

of it should also be a product our merchants pay for.

That is the job.

================================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================================

You will own risk, fraud and compliance as a product line — not as a cost

centre. You are being hired to design, build and ship products that reduce loss,

shorten onboarding, and generate revenue: fraud screening our merchants opt into,

chargeback and dispute tooling they will pay for, underwriting and KYB

capabilities we can sell or embed, monitoring and reporting our larger merchants

and platform partners need in order to grow on us.

This is a builder's role with a regulator's discipline. You will spend your week

between a compliance officer, a backend engineer and a merchant, and you will be

the person who can hold all three conversations without a translator.

================================================================================

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

================================================================================

Revenue products

  • Define, price and ship monetisable risk and fraud products: fraud scoring

    and screening tiers, chargeback protection and representment tooling,

    dispute automation, merchant-facing risk dashboards, KYB / identity

    verification as a paid capability, and risk services for platform and

    marketplace partners.

  • Build the commercial case: attach rate, pricing model, loss economics,

    payback. Own the P&L logic of what you ship, not just the roadmap.

  • Work with Sales and Partnerships to take these products to market — you will

    be in customer calls, and you will lose some of them and learn why.

Compliance and risk engineering

  • Own the product surface of transaction monitoring, sanctions and PEP

    screening, merchant onboarding and KYB, prohibited-industry and MCC policy

    enforcement, and chargeback and fraud loss controls.

  • Turn regulatory obligations and internal policy into shipped system

    behaviour: rules, thresholds, queues, audit trails, evidence packs,

    escalation paths and reporting.

  • Drive rule tuning and alert quality as a product metric. False positive

    rate, analyst minutes per alert and precision at the top of the queue are

    yours to move.

  • Evaluate, integrate and manage third-party vendors — fraud engines,

    screening providers, device intelligence, identity — including build vs.

    buy calls and commercial negotiation support.

Stakeholder leadership

  • Be the trusted counterpart to the Compliance and MLRO function. You will not

    ship around them, and they will not be surprised by what you ship.

jobs.desc:
We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. jobs.title: 1st Product Manager
jobs.desc:
The company

Ooak Data turns company data into training data for AI agents.

Frontier labs can train models to reason. They cannot train them to work: navigating a real company's Slack threads, half-finished Notion docs, contradictory Jira tickets, and permission boundaries. That requires real enterprise data, and you cannot synthesize it. You have to source it.

We plug into enterprise tools, anonymize everything into a structurally identical digital twin, and generate reinforcement-learning environments with expert-level tasks calibrated against frontier models.

We are a Y Combinator company with 7 figures signed contracts with three frontier AI labs, and we are scaling delivery aggressively over the next twelve months. Three founders, full-time since December 2025: Pierre-Louis (CEO, ex-COO in edtech, sold data to frontier labs), Grégoire (CPO, first PM & head of Ops at Epsor through Series B), Thomas (CTO, ex-Head of Data at PayLead, ex-Samsung AI lab).

Why this role exists

Our engineering team ships faster than founders can specify. We have four product surfaces, most of them internal, all of them technical, and every one of them decides whether an environment ships this week or next.

We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the product: what gets built, in what order, and whether it actually made us faster.

What you will own

The full chain, from the moment a CEO agrees to share their data to the moment a frontier lab receives an environment.

Partner experience

  • The Data Hub, onboarding and export tutorials a CEO sees when they hand us their company's history. Trust and speed at the top of the funnel.

The data pipeline

  • Connectors, ingestion and anonymisation. How raw Slack, Drive, mail and CRM exports become a clean digital twin. You will spend a lot of time with Thomas (CTO) here.

Pharos, our delivery platform

  • The internal tool our Ops team lives in to run QA and delivery. Throughput is the metric. This is where 3 env a week becomes 10.

RL environments

  • The thing the labs buy. Task design, calibration, what separates a dataset from a real agent training ground.

You will run two kinds of work at once: short projects that need tight coordination across Tech, Ops and GTM this week, and long ones where nothing exists yet and you get to decide what should.

Who you are

  • A doer. You know the product methodologies and you use them when they help, not by the book. Your instinct when something is slow is to fix it, not to schedule a workshop about it.
  • AI-pilled. You vibe code. You prototype before you write a spec. You design your own mockups. You are curious about how the models themselves are built and trained.
  • UX taste, ROI brain. Our workflows have to be brutally efficient. You judge a piece of software or a workflow by efficient it allows us to be or what value it brings to our customers.
  • You keep pace. Our engineers ship a lot. You turn that into something coherent rather than slowing it down.
  • 7+ years in product, at least some of it technical: data, infra, ML, developer tools or ops platforms. Founders and first PMs who built the function from nothing are very welcome.
  • Fluent French and English. Our customers are American, our data partners spread worldwide, our team speaks both.
  • Based in Paris.

The extra that make the difference

  • A research streak: you read papers, you have opinions on RL, you have trained or fine-tuned something.

Terms

  • Compensation: €70-90k + bonus, and 0.2% to 0.5%

jobs.desc:
### **The Role:**

We are looking for a Product Owner who will take full ownership of a defined product surface within our platform — whether that is shared infrastructure, a new product being built from scratch, a specialized law enforcement workflow, or a data-driven analytics experience. You will work as a trio alongside a lead engineer and a junior engineer, using our AI-augmented software development lifecycle to deliver at a pace that traditionally required much larger teams. This is not a traditional product manager role: you own scope, priority, and delivery accountability in one seat, and you produce complete, engineering-ready specifications that your engineering pair can build from directly.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Own your product surface end to end — deciding what gets built, when it ships, and how it serves your users or consuming teams, with full accountability for scope, priority, and quality
* Produce engineering-ready specifications for all features — complete user flows, visual designs, data requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria — using AI tools as a core part of your workflow; engineering builds from your specifications directly, without ambiguity about what the experience should be
* Make priority decisions and defend them — customer success, sales, and leadership will bring you requests; you decide which enter the roadmap and which don’t, with clear reasoning and transparent communication
* Maintain deep fluency with your customers — whether they are law enforcement practitioners, agency administrators, internal platform consumers, or data science teams — through direct engagement, user research, and ongoing relationship-building
* Conduct or commission user research as needed — interviews, usability testing, workflow observation, product analytics review — and engage internal subject matter experts to ground product decisions in direct evidence rather than assumptions
* Partner directly with your engineering pair as a trio; bring clarity on what to build and why while they bring clarity on how to build it and what is feasible
* Own post-launch adoption and feedback — evangelize new capabilities, train internal teams, track feature adoption, gather user feedback, maintain documentation, and iterate based on real-world usage rather than handing off after launch
* Support enterprise sales conversations with substantive product and domain knowledge when needed — not just feature lists, but the depth that builds customer confidence
* Leverage AI tools and technologies across all aspects of your work — research, specification, design, analysis, prototyping, and documentation

### **Requirements:**

* 5+ years of professional experience in product management, technical product management, engineering, design, or another role where you owned both the what and the how of a product or technical surface
* Demonstrated ability to produce engineering-ready specifications — not just PRDs or user stories, but complete specifications including visual designs, user flows, data requirements, and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from directly
* Fluency with AI-assisted workflows; you already use AI tools daily in your professional work and can demonstrate how they accelerate your output and raise the quality of your work
* Strong written and verbal communication; you write clearly enough that engineers can build from your documents and customers or stakeholders can understand your roadmap
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an agile or continuous-delivery environment as a genuine partner, not just a requirements source
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills — you think in terms of evidence, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes; you use data to frame problems, evaluate options, and build the case for decisions
* Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources — customer feedback, user research, internal expertise, data, competitive context — into clear product d

Allocortech does not need a backlog janitor. We need someone who understands why four-quadrant FOC, voltage class, SWaP-C, and certification timeline are the product — and can turn that into a roadmap OEMs will buy.

Taurus motor controllers, Clio power/comms hubs, and the surrounding battery/PDU work already power eVTOL, hybrid cargo aircraft, and electric hydrofoils. Your job is to productize that stack.

**What you will do**

* Partner with sales on positioning, spec sheets, and which custom asks become catalog.
* Keep the 18-month versus 24-month product bets honest.

### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

jobs.desc:
**Reflect Health** is a premier healthcare administration company located in Mason, Ohio. We offer self, level, and fully funded solutions that lower costs while improving outcomes with a consumer-centric experience. Our integrated benefits, services, and technology platform are designed to meet the needs of employers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and health systems. With a nationwide presence, we have the capability to sell and service in every state.

The **Product Owner** is responsible for managing and enhancing our healthcare data integration and reporting capabilities. This position serves as a critical link between clients, vendors, and internal technical teams, ensuring business needs are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions. They will lead initiatives focused on optimizing EDI workflows, custom reporting outputs, and technical processes.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Solution Design:** Develop and communicate clear, actionable user stories and product requirements that align with healthcare and regulatory data standards.
* **Client & Stakeholder Engagement:** Collaborate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to understand integration and reporting needs, ensuring requirements are effectively captured and addressed.
* **Operational Oversight:** Manage key data exchange processes, including Cigna-specific technical flows, with accountability for monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.
* **Strategic Delivery:** Drive initiatives to improve the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of EDI workflows and reporting solutions, particularly for healthcare transactions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data, and operational teams to ensure seamless delivery of technical solutions that support business goals.
* **Agile Leadership:** Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and backlog grooming, to maintain momentum on key initiatives and ensure transparency across stakeholders.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to enhance system performance and user experience based on feedback, metrics, and industry best practices.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Provide timely updates to leadership on project progress, risks, and outcomes, ensuring alignment with company objectives.

**Qualifications**:

* **Background:** Proven experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role focused on technical delivery and client engagement.
* **Data Knowledge:** Strong understanding of EDI transactions, including 834, 837, and 835 files, and related healthcare data exchange processes.
* **Technical & Reporting:** Proven ability to work with data teams to design and deliver custom reporting solutions based on complex business needs.
* **Industry Expertise:** Familiarity with Cigna-specific data workflows and healthcare claims/eligibility processes is a plus.
* **Agile Practices:** Comfortable operating in Agile environments with tools like Jira and Confluence.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities with a focus on translating complex technical topics into business-friendly language.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess root causes, propose solutions, and drive resolution.
* **Data Handling:** Ability to meet client contractual and Business Associate Agreement requirements governing access to protected health information, including approved processing locations.

**Compensation**:

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be.

Joining our team means embracing a fast-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you.

Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Brief Summary of Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use - and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most.

You’ll own a meaningful product area end-to-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve.

You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t).

**What you'll Do**

* **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned.
* **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building.
* **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun.
* **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch.
* **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

jobs.desc:
**About SignalQuest**

SignalQuest is a successful, privately held technology company based in Lebanon, New Hampshire. For more than two decades, SignalQuest has designed and manufactured rugged sensors used in demanding environments across industries including heavy equipment, industrial systems, and machine control. Our sensors are trusted by major OEMs and leading machine control companies worldwide. All engineering and manufacturing are performed onsite in Lebanon.

The company is launching a new brand and product line, Kinsman (kinsmanpro.com), to sell GPS jobsite measurement systems to small business earthwork contractors. This is a major market opportunity, and SignalQuest is building the team to make it happen.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an outstanding **Product Manager** to help build and scale the Kinsman SitePoint product line.

SitePoint combines precision GNSS RTK and INS technology, rugged hardware, and an intuitive mobile application to help earthwork contractors measure, lay out, grade, and complete jobs more efficiently. Our goal is to make sophisticated positioning technology useful to contractors who may never have used GPS or traditional machine-control systems before.

This is a highly hands-on product role. You will work directly with customers, engineers, designers, sales, and company leadership to identify important customer problems, define effective solutions, and drive those solutions from concept through release and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines **exceptional customer instincts with analytical and technical depth**. You should be equally comfortable talking with an excavator operator on a jobsite, thinking through the accuracy requirements of a measurement workflow, writing a detailed product specification, and project managing features to success.

You will report directly to the **President of Kinsman** and will have significant responsibility for shaping both the product and the way the Kinsman team builds it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Develop a deep understanding of Kinsman customers, their workflows, tools, frustrations, and business priorities
* Spend significant time talking directly with customers and observing how they work in real-world jobsite environments
* Identify important customer problems and distinguish meaningful product opportunities from isolated feature requests
* Develop strong intuition for what makes a product simple, useful, and valuable to small earthwork contractors
* Translate customer feedback, support issues, usage data, and field observations into clear product insights
* Validate new concepts and workflows with customers before and after development
* Maintain a strong understanding of competing products, industry workflows, and relevant technology

**Product Definition**

* Define clear product requirements for new features, workflows, and product improvements
* Translate complex technical capabilities into simple user experiences
* Develop detailed specifications, workflows, diagrams, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering and design teams can execute against
* Think carefully about usability, accuracy, reliability, safety, and real-world operating conditions
* Work through product details before development while remaining flexible as new information emerges
* Make thoughtful tradeoffs between customer value, simplicity, technical complexity, development effort, and speed
* Ensure product decisions remain consistent with the broader Kinsman product vision and target customer

**Product Development & Execution**

* Own product initiatives from initial customer problem through definition, design, development, testing, launch, and iteration
* Work closely with software, firmware, hardware, mechanical, and design teams throughout the development process
* Maintain clear priorities and ensure the team understands what is being built, why it matters, and what constitutes a successful result
*

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.

  

**Which product you'll own**

We run four consumer products and we are hiring product managers for all of them.

* **Galatea** — serialized fiction, millions of readers, coins and subscription
* **CandyJar** — the #1 US-based microdrama platform, billions of episodes streamed
* **Ironblood** — our new AI-native streaming platform for action and adventure
* **Inkitt** — the writing and discovery platform underneath all of it, where the stories come from

**We decide which one you own at the point you start, not at the point you apply.** When you join, we look at where the largest metric gap is across the portfolio and put you there. As the team grows, areas get reshuffled — people move to where the biggest problem is.

We are telling you this up front because it is a real feature of working here, and because it does not suit everyone. If you want to own one named surface for three years, this is the wrong company. Some of our strongest product managers were hired for one thing and were doing something else entirely within a year — including one who was brought in to build internal tooling and ended up launching CandyJar from zero.

  

**How We Work — please read this part carefully**

This role works differently from most product jobs, and the difference matters more than anything else on this page.

Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. **You own the ideas.** You will own an app or area end to end, and you will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas. Every product manager here keeps a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for their area — a new idea only enters that list by beating one already on it.

You pitch ideas to Ali on a single slide with a rough impact calculation attached. He rejects the ones that will not move the number enough to justify building them. That happens often, to everyone, and it is not a signal that anything has gone wrong.

Once an idea is approved, you own execution: spec, design, engineering, launch, and the A/B test. You release and ramp tests on your own judgement. **Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it.**

Your performance is measured on exactly two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

If that sounds like the job you want, the rest of this page is for you.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own an app or area end to end — the roadmap, the backlog, the revenue and retention of it
* Generate the ideas. Research competitors, the market and our users daily, and keep a ranked Top 3 that you are constantly trying to beat
* Build the impact case before you build the feature: size the opportunity, show the maths, defend the number
* Pitch to Ali, take the rejection, sharpen it, come back
* Drive approved work through spec, design, engineering, QA and launch
* Design and run A/B tests, ramp them responsibly, and read the results honestly — including when you lost
* Publish what you learn, wins and losses alike, to the whole company
*

**About Reserv**

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

**Location Requirement**

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in **California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.**

**About the role**

As the Senior Product Manager, Data at Reserv, you will be at the forefront of driving the

development and innovation of our data-centric products. Working at the intersection of

business, technology, and customer experience, you will be responsible for managing data

products that support our insurance services and operations. You will lead the strategy,

execution, and delivery of data solutions, leveraging insights to improve decision-making,

enhance operational efficiency, and provide value to our customers.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, data science, operations, and business

teams to ensure our data products align with the company’s goals. You will oversee the product

lifecycle, from gathering requirements to launching new features, and continuously optimize

product performance to meet evolving market needs.

**Who you are**

* **Data-Driven**: You possess strong data analytics skills, using data to inform product decisions and measure success, with experience in business intelligence tools and performance metrics.
* **Technically Proficient**: You understand data architecture, analytics platforms, and are comfortable working with engineering teams to build robust data solutions.
* **Customer-Focused**: You have a customer-centric approach, gathering insights and transforming them into product features that enhance customer experience and drive value.
* **Strategic Thinker**: You have the ability to align product strategy with business objectives, identifying opportunities for innovation and growth within the data landscape.
* **Agile Practitioner**: You are experienced in Agile methodologies, able to manage backlogs, lead sprint planning, and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* **Collaborative Leader**: You work well with cross-functional teams, influencing stakeholders at all levels and fostering a collaborative environment to achieve product goals.
* **Excellent Communicator**: You have strong communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts and product visions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem Solver**: You are skilled at analyzing problems, identifying solutions, and making data-informed decisions to drive product success.
* **Adaptable & Innovative**: You thrive in an evolving environment, staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to keep products competitive.

**What we need**

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  

* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners

jobs.desc:
**About Clair**
---------------

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help bring one of Clair's next products to life.

The product you'll initially work on exists today in successful private beta and is actively being expanded. That means you'll have a unique opportunity to join early in the product journey and help shape how we take an idea from concept to a real-world product and experience.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly defined roadmap or be handed a clear playbook for success. We have a direction, a problem we're working to solve, and a vision, but there is still plenty to figure out. You'll help turn ambiguity into action, make smart decisions with imperfect information, and work alongside a small, highly collaborative team to build, test, learn, and iterate quickly.

At Clair, building products is uniquely complex. We're an embedded fintech company, which means great product decisions require balancing the needs of our users with partner priorities and internal business demands, all while operating within a regulated environment. You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, finance, regulatory, operations, go-to-market, and partner teams to navigate those competing inputs and find the best path forward.

We're looking for a builder who is comfortable with gray areas, thinks outside the box, and isn't afraid to try something that might not work. You know how to move quickly without being reckless and understand that failing fast is only valuable if you're learning fast, too.

You won't be joining a team with every answer already mapped out. You'll help us find them.

**If you need someone to tell you exactly how to win, this probably isn't the role for you.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Identify, evaluate, and help define opportunities for new Clair products and experiences, often before the problem or solution is fully understood.
* Define and execute product strategy and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Partner closely with engineering and design to move quickly from concept to experiment to product, balancing speed with thoughtful execution.
* Build, test, learn, and iterate quickly—knowing when to invest further and when to fail fast and move on.

* Partner with regulatory, finance, operations, and other internal stakeholders to navigate complex requirements without losing sight of the user experience.
* Bring the voice of the customer into product strategy, roadmap discussions, and day-to-day product decisions.
* Analyze market trends, emerging customer

**About Ande**  
We're a Series A startup building an AI-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  
Corporate teams spend billions every year on business entertainment, dinners, events, client experiences, and almost none of it runs through purpose-built software. At the center of our platform are AI agents that do real work for our customers: agents that carry multi-step, high-stakes workflows through to completion, with real money and real relationships on the line. We're looking for a PM to own these agentic experiences. There's no established playbook for this work; the patterns for running agents in production are being figured out in real time, by a small number of teams, and we're one of the teams doing the inventing. You'll own how our agents behave, how their quality is measured and improved, and how the system earns the trust to take on more. AI isn't a feature we bolted on, it's the foundation of our product and how we run the company: we automate what can be automated so people spend their time on judgment, not busywork. As a PM here, you'll prototype ideas yourself, get answers from data without waiting on anyone, and ship faster than you're probably used to.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end experience our customers have with our AI agents, from first interaction to completed outcome
* Own agent quality as a product: evaluation frameworks, review loops, and the metrics that define "good" for a production agent
* Own the division of labor between agents and people, where automation earns more autonomy, and where human judgment stays in the workflow
* Own the improvement engine: the feedback loops and mechanisms that make agents measurably better every week, at growing volume
* Define, prioritize, and execute the roadmap for our agentic product experiences
* Go deep in the mechanics: prompt and context engineering, evals, failure analysis; you'll read transcripts, find patterns, and turn them into product decisions
* Partner with engineering to ship improvements fast, and build the tooling that makes quality visible and measurable
* Work closely with the operations teams whose workflows interlock with the agents; they're part of your product surface
* Coordinate with PMs across the product group, since the agents touch nearly every part of the customer journey
* Track the frontier: new patterns, research, and techniques emerge weekly in this space, and part of your job is knowing what's real, what's noise, and what we should try next

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, including hands-on work shipping agentic workflows
* Fluency in the patterns of production agentic systems, things like escalation and handoff design, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, feedback loops, and eval-driven development, and the judgment to know which pattern fits which problem
* A habit of staying at the edge: this field reinvents itself every few months, and you're the kind of person who's already tried the new technique before most people have heard of it
* Systems thinking; you see the agent, the people around it, the feedback loops, and the failure modes as one system, and you design for the whole
* An empirical mindset; you'd rather read fifty transcripts than debate a hypothesis, and you know quality is measured, not assumed
* Strong technical fluency, comfortable with prompt and context engineering, and able to work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers on agent architecture
* High agency; you spot what matters, take ownership, and run without waiting for permission

==========================

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

============

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to be the single product owner for the data engineering family — the data platform, analytics, data science, and the AI and agentic workflows built on top of them. Today this work is spread across technical leads and absorbed informally, with no one setting direction across the whole. Your job is to change that: decide what the data organization builds and why, get stakeholders aligned behind it, and make sure engineers can stay heads-down on the work that matters.

This is a hybrid Pioneer/Settler role: you'll get lightweight demos and PoCs built on ambiguous problems, and you'll bring order and cohesive ownership to data work streams that already exist. You'll prioritize ruthlessly and visibly — being explicit about what will not be worked on — and set direction rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

==================

* Decide which new data streams get integrated, when, and to what standard as new sensors and sources come online.
* Set the bar for what "supported" and "correct" mean as tools graduate from scripts and spreadsheets, and be explicit about what won't be migrated.

**How You'll Operate**
======================

* **Structure from ambiguity:** Bring direction to cross-disciplinary initiatives and align stakeholders rather than waiting for direction.

* **Hybrid Pioneer/Settler:** Get initial prototypes built with stakeholders, then write the roadmap to validate the use case and, if worth it, take it to production.
* **Ecosystem fluency:** Understand where Mariana's data sits relative to the systems that consume it and relative to the current frontier of LLM capability, so prioritization calls stay well-calibrated.

* Enough depth in data infrastructure and analytics to earn credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts, and to know when a technical answer is a good one
* Working fluency with the current LLM/foundation-model landscape and whe
