**About Us**

Wag! Group Co. strives to be the number one platform to solve the service, product, and wellness needs of the modern U.S. pet household. Wag! pioneered on-demand dog walking in 2015 with the Wag! app, offering access to 5-star dog walking, sitting, and one-on-one training from a community of over 500,000 Pet Caregivers nationwide. Additionally, Wag! Group Co. operates Petted, one of the nation’s largest pet insurance comparison marketplaces; Dog Food Advisor, a leading pet food review platform; WoofWoofTV, reaching over 18 million followers with delightful pet content on social media; and maxbone, a digital platform for modern pet essentials, offering superfoods for dogs and stylish, functional products for today’s pet owners. For more information about our company, visit Wag.co. and wagwalking.com

  

**The Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the Wag! Services web experience end to end. Wag! is a mature two-sided marketplace run with a startup mentality. Our web surface touches both sides of it: the booking funnel where pet parents find caregivers and the onboarding funnel our caregivers apply in. You will own the web roadmap and communicate the strategy and impact to leadership. Day to day, you draft tickets, approve designs, and run the experiments that tell us what to roll out. This is a hands-on role working directly with engineering, design, and analytics. This role is full-time and in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for current or future employment visa sponsorship.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

Booking Funnel and Experimentation

* Own the pet parent web booking funnel from page landing through service completion for new and returning customers
* Run the web A/B testing program end to end
* Find and fix conversion leaks across landing pages, signup, and booking flows

Growth Surfaces

* Own our SEO and marketing pages: page structure, speed, internal linking, and click through rate
* Partner with Marketing on new landing pages and acquisition surface improvements

Caregiver Onboarding Funnel

* Own the caregiver onboarding funnel from sign-up to approved application
* Balance dev resources between supply-side and demand-side work

Core Responsibilities

* Maintain a quarterly roadmap broken into weekly sprints
* Draft PRDs and tickets with requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering
* Leverage dashboards and reports to own daily and weekly performance reporting
* Use AI tools to draft initial designs and prototypes before looping in the designer
* Communicate performance metrics to leadership including funnel conversion rates

  

**Minimum Paw-lifications**

* 3+ years of product management experience on a consumer web product
* Experience owning a web booking or conversion funnel
* Experience running A/B tests end to end, including sizing, instrumentation, and ship/revert decisions
* Comfortable working with data, Excel, and basic BI tool proficiency
* Actively use AI and emerging tools to improve workflows and productivity
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Strong sense of ownership and eagerness to make an impact across teams

* Ability to work in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office

  

**Purr-furred Paw-lifications**

* Working proficiency in SQL
* Experience in a two-sided marketplace
* Experience with a feature-flag or experimentation platform such as Split, LaunchDarkly, or Optimizely
* Familiarity with Snowflake, Mixpanel, or a comparable analytics stack
* SEO and landing page experience, particularly on a large content footprint
* Subscription or membership product experience
* Interest in consumer marketplaces, two-sided platforms, or pet/consumer wellness

  

**Benefits & Purrr-ks**

* Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Complimentary parking on-site at our dow

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Zlayt AI is a litigation automation platform built exclusively for personal injury law. From demand letters and deposition summaries to discovery responses and case analysis, Zlayt equips law firms with intelligent tools that draft faster, think strategically, and deliver results without friction, setup, or compromise.

We're an early-stage, product-led company building the category-defining product for legal AI in a large, underserved niche. This is a rare opportunity to shape what the product becomes — working directly with the founding team, real PI lawyers, and real case data.

**The Role**

Zlayt AI is hiring a Product Manager to own the product from problem to shipped feature. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering to decide what we build, why, and in what order — then make sure it ships and actually works for the lawyers and legal assistants who use it every day.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. There is no product org to step into. You'll be writing the first specs, running the first structured discovery, and setting up how product decisions get made.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the product roadmap: talk to PI lawyers and staff, find the highest-value workflow problems, and turn them into a prioritized plan
* Write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guesswork
* Work hands-on with AI: define how features should behave, test outputs against real legal work product, and set the quality bar for what "good enough to ship" means
* Run discovery and feedback loops with early customers, including Zinda Law Group as the first major client
* Define and track the metrics that show whether a feature is working (adoption, time saved, output quality, retention)
* Operate with significant ambiguity in an early-stage environment, making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting quickly

  

**Who You Are**

* **A builder, not an inheritor:** You've shipped a 0-to-1 software product or major feature as the accountable PM — you know what it takes to build something from nothing, not just run an existing roadmap
* **Technical enough to be dangerous:** You've worked directly with engineers day to day, can read a technical design, and don't need a translator to discuss APIs, data models, or model behavior
* **AI-native:** You've shipped or worked hands-on with LLM or AI-powered features, and you use AI tools yourself to do your own work faster
* **Workflow-obsessed:** You've built software for a demanding professional user — legal, healthcare, finance, or similar — where the details of the workflow decide whether the product gets used
* **Startup-tested:** You've worked in small, fast-moving companies where you had to build process yourself, not step into one that already existed
* **Self-directed:** Your track record shows work you personally drove — not just team results you were adjacent to
* **Experienced but still hands-on:** Roughly 4–10 years of total professional experience, with at least 3 in product management
* **Stable but not stagnant:** A track record of meaningful tenure at each stop, with job changes that make sense (promotions, acquisitions, layoffs, or clear career logic — not a pattern of short stints)

  

**Our Philosophy**

We firmly uphold the value of every individual within our team, ensuring they have the chance to build a rewarding career both financially and personally. Our firm's structure is designed to offer exceptional prospects for growth and advancement. At Zlayt AI, every team member leaves at the end of the day with the satisfaction of knowing they have diligently served our clients and positively impacted the lives of others. Join us and experience a remarkable work environment at our organization!

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.desc:
**Why Wellthy is for you!**

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.  
  
We're building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we're seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what's possible.  
  
Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families' real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, especially around emerging technologies. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.

Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we're building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.

We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.  
  
We're building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we're looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.

**As our Product Manager II**, you will work in a management capacity to shape the future of our product. You will help build and deliver solutions to better support our caregiving members, enable our internal care teams to more efficiently deliver a world-class experience, and showcase the value of our service to our clients. You will lead efforts around product vision, prioritization, and scoping.

**You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer.**

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

* **Product Vision & Strategy:** Owning and championing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning stakeholders and leadership while exercising strong judgment to prioritize what gets built and why.
* **Hands-On Discovery:** Leading a rigorous discovery process by running user interviews, conducting experiments, and analyzing data to uncover insights and validate hypotheses.
* **Execution & Collaboration:** Working side-by-side with engineers, designers, and data professionals to clarify requirements, solve roadblocks, and guide the development of high-impact features.
* **Innovation:** Actively identifying opportunities to leverage AI and other emerging technologies to create a competitive advantage and deliver step-change improvements to the user experience.
* **Ownership & Impact:** Defining success metrics, tracking product performance against key business goals, and taking full ownership of the product lifecycle from launch to sunset.
  

**Qualifications**

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be open to learning, experimenting, and evolving. Comfort with emerging technology and curiosity around how tools like AI can support your workflow or help families more effectively is a plus.

* You are a builder who is energized by learning, experimenting, and evolving. You actively seek to apply emerging technologies, especially AI, to enhance your workflow, build smarter products, and more effectively support the members we serve.

At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Broadridge Asset Management Solutions**

Broadridge Asset Management is a premier provider of investment software, supporting over 600 clients across hedge funds, CLO managers, private credit funds, fund administrators, asset owners, and traditional asset managers. We are seeking a technically strong Product Owner to help drive the evolution of our public and private credit capabilities across our asset management software suite.

**Role Overview**

As a Product Owner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Broadridge’s investment technology. Partnering closely with the Head of Product, you will influence how clients leverage our platform to streamline investment workflows—from research and order management to portfolio management, accounting, and data & analytics.

You will collaborate cross-functionally with clients, engineering, UX/UI design, QA, client services, and business stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions that enhance productivity, reduce operational risk, and improve efficiency across the investment lifecycle.

In this role, you will serve as a highly proficient member of the product team, bridging the gap between Product Management and Engineering.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with product leadership to shape and execute product strategy and roadmap
* Maintain a pulse on industry, market, and technology trends to identify opportunities for innovation and client value
* Own the delivery of new features and workflows across Broadridge’s credit investment suite, including syndicated loans, private debt, and CLO management
* Serve as the embedded Product Owner within agile squads, driving sprint planning, backlog grooming, and execution
* Collaborate with engineering to design scalable, reusable solutions
* Author clear, actionable epics, user stories, and non-functional requirements (NFRs) using best practices (INVEST, MVP, steel threads)
* Oversee end-to-end release processes, ensuring timely, high-quality deployments across environments

* Provide adaptable support across client demos, product documentation, and business analysis

**Your Profile**

* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into detailed product requirements
* Familiarity with Broadridge SentryPM is a strong plus, or other Syndicated Loan, Private Credit, or CLO investment systems

* Proficiency in modern product development methodologies; roadmap, sprint planning and backlog management
* Skilled in Microsoft Office, Jira, Confluence; SQL experience is a plus
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**THE POSITION**  
Our roster has an opening with your name on it

The Product Manager is responsible for the planning and execution of successful product initiatives. This includes understanding and prioritizing product and customer needs, defining product goals, and working closely with engineering, product owners, and business stakeholders to bring solutions to market. The role monitors product performance through market analysis, a deep understanding of customer needs, and objective data analysis and reporting.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

* Inform, shape, and drive execution of specific Casino product initiatives
* Establish and maintain domain expertise on the product, market, and competitors
* Assess product opportunities and contribute meaningfully to ideation and prioritization for new
* initiatives and products
* Ensure transparency and alignment with organizational stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering, product owners, marketing and operational functions to ensure successful product deliveries and launches
* Identify, prioritize, and execute post-launch optimizations and improvements
* Track and report objectively on product performance, including an understanding of related incidents
* Be the "Canadian Champion" – always ensuring our Canadian customer preferences are considered and their requirements met

**THE STATS**  
What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Minimum 2+ years' experience as a product manager or similar role required
* Proven track record of delivering successful and innovative products
* Ability to handle multiple simultaneous projects while effectively balancing scope, resourcing, time, and quality
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for goals and deliverables
* Demonstrated success cross-functionally influencing teams without formal authority
* Strong quantitative skills
* Excellent critical thinking skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  

**ABOUT FANDUEL**

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

**PLAYER BENEFITS**  
We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. jobs.desc:
**Summary**
  
  
The Product Manager is responsible for supporting the direction, delivery, and ongoing success of assigned Naviam products. This role manages the product roadmap, backlog, requirements, release priorities, and cross-functional coordination for approximately two to three products, ensuring that product execution aligns with company strategy, customer needs, delivery realities, quality expectations, and engineering capacity.  
  
The Product Manager serves as a key collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholders. This role translates business goals, customer feedback, implementation learnings, and market insights into clear product requirements and actionable development priorities. While overall commercial and product strategy is led by senior product leadership, the Product Manager may provide input based on customer discovery, delivery feedback, product usage, and market observations.  
  
Success in this role requires strong communication, practical decision-making, attention to detail, and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, delivery timelines, testing readiness, and product quality in a B2B enterprise software environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the roadmap, backlog, priorities, and product direction for assigned products, typically overseeing two to three products.
* Define, document, and communicate product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities, and product decisions.
* Serve as a primary collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholder teams.
* Work closely with engineering teams during planning, refinement, sprint execution, review, and release activities to support clear prioritization and successful delivery.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance on testing scope, test planning, feature validation, defect review, regression considerations, and release readiness.
* Help ensure new features and product changes are clearly defined, testable, and aligned with expected functionality before release.
* Partner with delivery, implementation, customer solutions, support, and customer-facing teams to gather feedback, identify recurring needs, and ensure product improvements address real-world enterprise use cases.
* Participate in customer, prospect, partner, and internal stakeholder conversations, including sales and delivery discovery calls, to understand needs, explain product direction, and gather feedback for future planning.
* Prioritize product work based on customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical considerations, quality, testing needs, and strategic alignment.
* Support release planning by helping define release scope, communicate planned functionality, review readiness, coordinate stakeholder awareness, and identify unresolved risks or dependencies.
* Maintain product documentation, including product requirements, feature definitions, internal enablement materials, release notes, testing coordination notes, and related product communication.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, delivery, and QA stakeholders to ensure features are usable, technically sound, practical to implement, and sufficiently validated.
* Help identify opportunities for product improvement, operational efficiency, product integration, and better alignment across Naviam’s enterprise software offerings.
* Monitor customer, market, and technology trends relevant to assigned products and use those insights to inform product recommendations and prioritization discussions.
* Support Agile and Scrum-based practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, review, retrospective activities, and ongoing coordination with delivery teams as appropriate.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
About GaggleAMP

GaggleAMP helps companies turn employees into active advocates on social media. Our customers run employee advocacy programs that drive brand visibility, sales engagement, and recruiting impact, all with minimal effort from the people involved. We've been at this for years, have real customers, and have a clear point of view about what we do and who we do it for.

Mission

Own product at GaggleAMP so that every feature we ship makes our customers' jobs genuinely easier and proves measurable value to their organizations, applying phase-one discipline and customer evidence to every decision.

Outcomes

We share this scorecard openly so you know exactly what success looks like.

**By day 30:**

* Reviewed at least 20 recorded customer calls and built working knowledge of customer pains and language patterns
* Held one-on-ones with each developer, the engineering lead, the customer success lead, the CEO, and at least two CS team members
* Read and internalized our product principles, persona docs, brand guide, and GTM playbook well enough to apply them in conversation
* Audited the current product backlog, can articulate what's in flight and why, and formed initial opinions on prioritization
* Scoped at least two product optimizations end-to-end (from usage data through a defined solution to engineering handoff)
* Produced a written first-impressions document for the CEO and engineering lead

**By day 90:**

* Shipped at least one meaningful piece of new work that you scoped, designed, and handed off, with engineering buy-in
* Own and run weekly product/design reviews independently
* Produced a roadmap proposal for the upcoming quarter, defined as the full mix of new capability, optimizations to existing flows, and infrastructure work that affects usability. Grounded in customer evidence and our product principles
* Built your own customer conversation cadence (at least two live customer calls per month)
* Reduced senior leadership involvement in feature-level product decisions to near zero
* Made at least one clearly defensible "no" to a feature request, based on principle application rather than capacity

Competencies

**Customer obsession and persona discipline.** Every product decision grounded in real customer evidence, applied to a specific persona, not imagined users.

**Phase-one scoping discipline.** Ship the smallest meaningful version first and let customer feedback drive what comes next. Comfortable cutting scope. Can defend "no" with reasoning.

**Strategic and tactical balance.** Real product work is a mix of new capability, optimizations, and usability-affecting infrastructure, not just new feature delivery. Resist the bias toward shipping new things at the expense of improving what exists.

**AI-leveraged execution with human ownership.** Use AI tools fluently across discovery, writing, design, and analysis. Own every outcome and deliverable as your own work, regardless of which tools helped produce it. AI is leverage, not a substitute for judgment.

**Scrappy execution and self-direction.** Operate without scaffolding. Build your own systems and rhythms. Comfortable with ambiguity. Direct in communication, including with leadership.

**Design fluency (a plus, not required).** Comfortable partnering on UI work and reviewing it against our design system. Hands-on Figma execution is a bonus.

How we work

Small team, fast cadence, customer-driven. You'll partner closely with engineering on a continuous shipping rhythm and have direct CEO engagement on product strategy. You'll own product end-to-end: there's no separate designer, no PM peer, no analyst pulling reports for you. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to.

This role is for builders, not process managers. If you want to talk to customers, make the strategic calls, influence the design of the screens, write the stories, and ship to real people who depend on the product, let's talk.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Improvado**
-------------------

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

**What we sell:** extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

**Who buys it:**

* *Economic buyers:* CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
* *Technical evaluators:* VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
* *Segments:* enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
* *Verticals:* pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

**Why this role, now**
----------------------

* **Our messaging is not aligned.** Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
* **The category is crowded and moving fast.** Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
* **Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost** — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
* **Analyst firms are a silent blocker.** When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Positioning and messaging.** Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
* **Competitive intelligence and win/loss.** A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
* **Sales enablement.** The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
* **Market and analyst relations.** The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
* Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
* B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
* Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards

**About Rhythm Energy**
-----------------------

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company redefining how people interact with energy. We combine energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver simple, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions.

We’re a mission-driven team focused on building scalable systems, solving complex problems, and making a meaningful impact on the future of energy.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring a Product Manager – Growth & Lifecycle to own the customer-facing products and experiences that bring customers to Rhythm and keep them here.

You’ll own the customer journey from enrollment through renewal, building products that make energy simpler and give customers the information they need to make confident decisions. We'll measure your success primarily by two outcomes: conversion and retention.

You’ll work closely with Marketing and our Head of Growth to identify opportunities and run experiments across the funnel, and with Product Design to create simple, intuitive customer experiences. You’ll own product requirements and final sign-off on customer-facing experiences before they move into development.

Churn reduction and retention are among Rhythm’s top product priorities, giving this role direct and visible impact on company results from day one.

We’re looking for an independent, decisive Product Manager who can lead the room, align stakeholders, make recommendations, and move decisions forward in a fast-paced environment.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Growth & Lifecycle Product Ownership**

* Own the roadmap for Rhythm’s customer-facing products across the lifecycle, including the enrollment journey, customer portal, retention, and renewal experiences.
* Drive measurable improvements in conversion and retention, establishing clear success metrics for initiatives and reporting on outcomes.
* Lead retention and churn reduction initiatives, identifying where customers drop off or disengage and building experiences designed to keep them with Rhythm.
* Use customer data, funnel analytics, segmentation, and user feedback to understand customer behavior and identify the highest-impact opportunities.
* Monitor product performance after launch and continuously iterate based on customer behavior and results.

### **Experimentation & Conversion**

* Partner closely with Marketing and the Head of Growth to turn growth opportunities into clear hypotheses and product experiments.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.desc:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Product Manager role, not a Full-stack role)
jobs.desc:
We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

At Designer Brands, we are the proud parent company of DSW Designer Shoe Warehouse, The Shoe Company, and Rubino, operating nearly 675 stores across North America and a billion-dollar digital commerce business. Anchored by our core values of “We Love What We Do,” “We Own What We Do,” “We Do What's Right,” and “We Belong,” we continuously drive forward together, building a future where everyone can put their best foot forward.

**Digital Product Manager**

**Location: Remote**

**Reports To:** Senior Digital Product Manager

At Designer Brands, we're passionate about creating digital experiences that make it easier, more inspiring, and more enjoyable for customers to engage with DSW. As a Digital Product Manager, you'll play a key role in shaping those experiences by turning ideas into impactful solutions that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.

In this role, you'll partner with teams across the organization to bring digital strategies to life, elevate the customer experience, and deliver results against key business objectives. You'll balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations to help determine what gets built, when it gets built, and how success is measured.

We're looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and energized by solving complex problems. You'll thrive if you enjoy learning new technologies, are passionate about digital experiences, and can bring people together around a shared vision.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the Product Management function of an Agile team, in close partnership with Development, and Business Analyst

At Avis Budget Group, we’re driven to be the best vehicle rental company in the world, together. **Company Overview**

Psomagen, Inc., founded in 2004 in Rockville, MD, is a leading provider of genetic and genomic testing services. The company delivers advanced sequencing solutions, including next-generation and Sanger sequencing, supported by comprehensive data analysis for basic research and scientific applications.

Psomagen operates CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratories, ensuring the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and reliability in its services.

Listed on the KOSDAQ in July 2020, Psomagen continues to expand its presence in the global research market, strengthening its capabilities in genomic services and data-driven solutions.

**Role Overview**

Psomagen is seeking an experienced Scientific Product Manager to own and grow our cutting-edge Multi-omics service portfolio (Single Cell, Spatial Genomics, Olink Proteomics). This is a critical on-site role at the center of Sales, Lab Operations, Bioinformatics (BI), and Clients. You will be the owner of these service offerings: defining what we sell, how it is scoped and priced, and how it is delivered, so that Sales can sell it with confidence and the lab can deliver it consistently.

The primary KPIs of this role are twofold: (1) to support Sales by providing the technical depth, product knowledge, and accurate commercial documents that help win and grow business, and (2) to align closely with the Psomagen laboratory so that every offering runs as a seamless, repeatable process across the entire business life cycle, from service design and quotation through sample intake, execution, data delivery, and customer feedback. You will combine scientific credibility with product thinking: understanding the customer, shaping the offering, and continuously improving it.

* Service performance: on-time delivery against committed turnaround times, first-pass success rate, and reduction in rework and re-runs.
* New and updated offerings launched on schedule with lab readiness, validated workflows, and trained sales staff.
* Speed and quality of issue resolution and client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) at project close.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership & Portfolio Strategy & Profitability:**

* Own the service portfolio, roadmap, and portfolio profitability for Single Cell, Spatial Genomics, and Olink Proteomics, including service definitions, standard packages, deliverables, specifications, and turnaround times.
* Work with Sales, Finance, and Lab leadership to develop pricing and packaging that is competitive, profitable, and operationally realistic.
* Monitor market trends, competitor CRO offerings, and new platforms, chemistries, and applications; build business cases for new or enhanced services.

**Technical Sales Support & Solution Design:**

* Thoroughly understand Psomagen’s laboratory workflows and technical capabilities, and represent the lab and the product with credibility when the sales team discusses projects with clients.
* Identify clients’ complex scientific requirements and research objectives, and translate them into optimal experimental design and customized solutions built on our standard offerings.

This is an opportunity for an experienced product manager to lead the development and execution of AI-powered technology initiatives across the business.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Discovery
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

With more than 283 million members in over 190 countries, Netflix continues to shape the future of entertainment around the world.

  
  

We want to invent entertainment experiences the world can’t live without, connecting people with stories they’ll love. The Member Experience Product Management team is accountable for making the core Netflix experience better every day for our members around the world. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes experiences and ranking/recommendations strategy across discovery/browse (shows, movies, live programming, and games), search, player, identity/profiles, and new surfaces.

  
  

Our team is hiring a Product Manager for Core Discovery. This role focuses on building product capabilities that help members more easily discover, choose, and engage with content across Netflix, whether that’s a series, film, game, podcast, or new content formats over time.

  
  

You will work on developing experiences and solutions that make choosing feel simple and intuitive, and help members quickly find something they want to watch or play. This work spans all platforms, including TV, mobile, tablet, and web, and requires thinking beyond individual features to build solutions that scale across surfaces, use cases, and content types.

  
  

You will define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for your area, grounded in member needs, data, and business priorities. You will work closely with cross-functional partners across engineering, data science, design, and research to take ideas from concept through execution and iteration. This role requires strong judgment in identifying the highest impact opportunities, balancing short-term improvements with longer-term investments, and building alignment across teams working on different parts of the member discovery experience.

  
  

This role is based in our Los Gatos (preferred) or Los Angeles office on a hybrid model, but we are open to considering remote candidates. Occasional travel to Los Gatos and Los Angeles will be required.

  
  

What we offer:

* The opportunity to have a huge impact. The products and features you will be working on are central to the product experience for hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
* Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.
* Learning. You will be creating customer experiences and business models that have never been done before. You will have the opportunity to work with stunning colleagues who value collaboration and from whom you can learn.
  

  

Who will be successful in this role?

You combine strong product judgment with the ability to work across a broad set of partners to define, explain, and execute on your product strategy. You are comfortable operating in complex and ambiguous spaces, and can translate member needs, data, and business context into a clear vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area. You partner effectively with cross-functional teams, including other product managers, engineering, data science, design, and research, to build and scale solutions that improve how members discover and engage with content. You think beyond individual features and consider how your work fits into the broader product ecosystem, identifying opportunities to simplify and extend capabilities across surfaces, use cases, and content types. You have a track record of shipping high-quality consumer products, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and driving measurable impact.

RUX Software is a fast-growing Microsoft Business Central ISV serving 500+ clients globally across equipment rental, construction, scaffolding, trenching/shoring, oilfield services, medical equipment, and related verticals. We're engineered to fit the industries we serve, and we hire people the same way.

  

RUX Software provides ERP solutions for industrial asset management and field service organizations. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability.

  

**Overview**

Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices.

**What This Position Owns**

* Visioning and Competitive Intelligence (20%): Shape domain direction using market signals, customer insight, and competitor analysis; propose strategic bets, positioning updates, and sequencing changes tied to business outcomes.
* Backlog and Sprint Readiness (15%): Own backlog health by prioritizing and preparing work so items are sprint-ready with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery sequencing.

* Customer Discovery and Validation (15%): Engage users and customers, including dispatchers, technicians, and service managers, to validate problems, test assumptions, and convert learning into better priorities and requirements.
* Solutioning and Tradeoff Work (10%): Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options and make practical decisions across customer value, effort, risk, scalability, and time to value.

* Quality Validation and Platform Release Readiness (10%): Confirm product behavior through UAT support, regression validation, and release-impact checks; stay current on major platform releases and features to protect compatibility and identify product opportunities.
* Documentation Review and Enablement Readiness (5%): Verify release documentation is accurate, complete, and usable across customer-facing guides, internal support notes, and enablement materials.
* KPI Review and Outcome Tracking (5%): Monitor adoption and service-performance metrics, interpret outcome trends, and feed learning back into roadmap and backlog decisions.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Success is measured by backlog health and sprint readiness; quality of product decisions and cross-team alignment; validated customer learning; timely resolution of priority issues; release quality and platform compatibility; documentation readiness; feature adoption; service-performance trends; and measurable movement in product and business outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain a fact-based product-domain perspective using customer feedback, support patterns, market signals, competitive research, platform changes, and performance data.
* Propose product bets, positioning changes, and roadmap sequencing updates with a clear connection to customer and business outcomes.

Product Manager  
  
Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.  
  
POSITION OVERVIEW  
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.  
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. *Judgment is still the job.*  
  
Key Responsibilities

* **Product strategy:** Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
* **Customer and market understanding:** Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
* **Discovery and user research:** Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
* **Requirements and definition:** Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
* **Prioritization:** Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
* **Agile delivery:** Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
* **Data-driven decision making:** Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
* **Go-to-market partnership:** Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
* **Communication:** Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
* **Problem solving:** Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features.

Ways of Working We Value  
The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.

* **Prototyping:** Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.
* **User experience design:** Strong instincts for information architecture, user flows, and interaction design. You can give a designer specific, useful feedback rather than adjectives.

jobs.title: Product Manager, File and Remit
jobs.desc:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50 US jurisdictions and 100+ countries. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

* 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies
* 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies
* Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Spark, Index, and Khosla Ventures.

Every month, Anrok files more tax returns than ever before, and the next month beats it. Behind each return is a company counting on us to file it correctly, on time, and get the money to the right government. Nobody else is set up to do this at our scale.

As the **File & Remit Product Manager**, you'll own the last mile of tax compliance: from preparing a return until the money reaches the tax authority. Everything else Anrok does builds up to this. You'll be solving two problems that shape the company:

**File every return in the world.** Our filing volume keeps setting records. The systems that got us here won't carry us through the next 10x. You'll define the filing platform that can file every return for every company in every jurisdiction. It should run itself, with automation that monitors and repairs its own problems and humans involved only for edge cases.

**Open Anrok to the world.** Today, a company based outside the US has to open a US bank account before it can remit through Anrok. For great international companies, that's often the last thing standing between them and Anrok. You'll build the remittance infrastructure that lets them pay from their local bank account in top international markets.

Our vision: tax filing is handled like magic, and sellers never have to think about it.

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

* Build a filing platform that scales to every return in the world, with most filings fully automated and zero human touches
* Put AI at the center of filing, with agents that write filing automations, catch problems before a filing period opens, and repair them automatically
* Unlock international sellers by making remittance work from their local bank accounts, in local currency
* Own money movement end to end, from collecting seller funds to landing payments at thousands of tax authorities across currencies, banking partners, and jurisdictions
* Build tools for our in-house TaxOps team, your power users, so they can do more jurisdictions with less effort
* Make the returns experience that sellers trust completely: every filing on time and accurate
* Drive the metrics that matter: cost per filing, 100% on-time filings, and fewer amendments
* Identify the next frontier, including whether Anrok's filing engine becomes a standalone platform of its own

**What excites us**
-------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, with 2+ years building B2B products
* Experience in payments, fintech, money movement, or high-volume operational systems
* Systems thinking: you design for 100x, not just for next month
* Comfort going deep technically alongside engineers building automation infrastructure
* High standards in places where a mistake costs a customer money
* A GM mindset with strong product and business instincts
* Clear, concise communication, verbal and written

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - Industrial Optimization & Analytics
jobs.desc:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Enterprise Product Owner is an individual contributor responsible for maximizing the business value, adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of the company’s manufacturing software platform (and other future technology solutions) used for plate inventory optimization, nesting, saw planning, remnant management, and cutting operations.  
  
This role serves as the bridge between Operations, Sales, and other software platform vendors, ensuring the technology, processes, data, and user capabilities effectively support Operations in driving measurable improvements in yield, throughput, inventory utilization, and customer service.  
  
The Product Owner will support six plate-processing facilities currently utilizing the applicable technology while developing the roadmap, standards, and business case for future deployment across additional locations (~25% travel).

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Ownership & Strategy

* Own the plate processing technology product roadmap and enhancement backlog.
* Define and prioritize business requirements based on operational value and ROI.
* Partner with Operations and Sales leadership to establish optimization standards and best practices.
* Develop long-term strategy for expanding plate processing technology capabilities and deployment across the enterprise.
* Evaluate new plate processing technology product modules, functionality, and integration opportunities.
* Establish and administer governance for business rules, system configuration, access, data ownership, enhancement prioritization, and deployment decisions.

Operations Optimization

* Drive improvements in:
  + Plate yield and material utilization (90% yield/ 5% Rem/ 5% Scrap target)
  + Remnant reduction and consumption
  + Saw productivity
  + Nesting efficiency
  + Inventory turns
  + On-time delivery performance
* Analyze cutting patterns and operational KPIs to identify optimization opportunities.
* Establish standardized operating procedures across all plate processing facilities.
* Monitor site adoption and ensure consistent execution.

Business Process Leadership

* Act as primary liaison between:
  + Plate processing operations
  + Production planning
  + Supply chain
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + Information Technology
* Gather and document business requirements.
* Lead process redesign efforts supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
* Facilitate alignment among stakeholders when prioritizing competing business needs.

Systems Integration & Technology Management

* Partner with IT to maintain integrations between plate processing technologies and enterprise systems, including:
  + ERP platforms (SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or equivalent)
  + Other MES and IoT systems (Machine Metrics, etc.)
  + Inventory management systems
  + Warehouse operations
  + Production scheduling systems
  + Reporting and analytics platforms
* Validate data quality and process integrity across connected systems.
* Define acceptance criteria, coordinate user acceptance testing, and provide business approval for production releases.

Analytics & Performance Management

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and KPIs.
* Measure business outcomes including:
  + Yield improvement
  + Scrap reduction
  + Remnant utilization
  + Throughput gains
  + Labor productivity
  + Inventory optimization
* Present performance results and improvement opportunities to senior leadership.
* Establish escalation and root-cause processes for recurring systems, data, material-allocation, and production-planning exceptions.
* Establish benefit targets for major enhancements and deployments and validate realized results following implementation.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as primary relationship manager with ARDIS (or other plate processing technology providers).
* Coordinate issue resolution, support escalations, and enhancement requests.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**Company Information**  
Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience.  
  
**Job Description**  
Clinical Ink is seeking a ***Product Owner*** to join our Product Management team based remotely across the United States! The Product Owner manages the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product stream, translating business and stakeholder needs into prioritized requirements and actionable user stories. This role drives delivery by setting sprint and release goals, coordinating dependencies, removing roadblocks, and tracking performance against key objectives. The Product Owner partners with development teams and internal and external stakeholders to communicate progress, incorporate feedback, and support successful releases through documentation and training. This role's responsibilities include:

* Create and manage product roadmap for given product stream
* Drive execution against roadmap by setting sprint and release goals, tracking KPIs, and removing team roadblocks
* Manage all aspects of the backlog from use case drafting, requirement/user story creation and prioritization, to grooming, and acceptance
* Effectively manage cross team dependencies with fellow product team members
* Schedule and conduct agile meetings (daily scrums, grooming, and planning) with Solutions Development team members to ensure successful execution against requirements and feature deliverables
* Regularly communicate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure transparency about deliverables and gain feedback as input to feature definition and development
* Contribute to release notes, product documentation, and training of cross functional team members for release readiness
* Advocate for Agile software development practices amongst your team.
* Regularly present to and communicate with senior leadership about team progress

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 3+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, with a strong emphasis on specification/ requirement writing
* Proficiency writing user stories and functional specifications for software applications
* Understanding of basic software design concepts and user interface controls
* Basic understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodology
* Previous experience using Confluence, JIRA, and/or similar tools required
* Strong interpersonal communication skills; ability to write in a clear and concise style
* Proficiency with basic computer skills, including spreadsheets and word processing
* Proactive attitude, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills; strong time management and organizational skills required

**Additional Information**  
Clinical Ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status.

jobs.desc:
**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** BrandRank.AI

**Duration:** Full Time

**Reports to:** Chief Product/Operations Officer

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and small-team pace.** You would rather own the outcome than wait for a process.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with search, or ranking and scoring systems.
* Experience working with large consumer brands or enterprise customers.
* Exposure to AI answer engines and how they source, cite and rank content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a cutting-edge startup that is revolutionizing brand strategy through AI-driven insights.
* **High-Impact Ownership:** Work directly with engineering and company leadership, with meaningful responsibility for how the product is defined, prioritized and communicated.
* **Small-Team Pace:** Join an early-stage environment where decisions move quickly, ownership is visible and everyone contributes to shipping.
* **Customer Proximity:** Work on product decisions that directly affect leading consumer brands and enterprise customers.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

You will work directly with customers, internal stakeholders, Product Development, User Experience, and other cross-functional partners to identify important customer problems and deliver solutions that provide measurable customer and business value. You will develop a deep understanding of component design and manufacturing workflows and become the product expert and primary advocate for your products.

* Participate in planning, refinement, demonstrations, release reviews, and other product-development activities.

jobs.desc:

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*

* Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition
* Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Order Management and Renewals Systems
jobs.desc:
Every month, hundreds of thousands of orders and renewals flow through Book of the Month's in-house software systems, and we are seeking a Technical Product Manager to own two of the most mission-critical pieces of software at the business: our Order Management System and our Renewal Management System. These mission critical systems are purpose built by our in-house product and engineering teams to support our subscription service and deliver the best new books to our members every month.. This is an ideal role for a technical PM who is equally obsessed with how systems work and how customers experience them.

**What you'll do...**

*Order Management*

* Own our Order Management System (OMS), which manages the entire lifecycle of an order from the moment a member clicks Ship to the moment it is delivered to our members.
* Be responsible for measuring and optimizing our shipping SLAs, and managing the roadmap that gets us there over time.
* Work and coordinate with key stakeholders to ensure that all updates are scoped well and releases are coordinated with associated updates to SOPs.

*Renewals*

* Own the product management of our Renewal Management System, which stages and processes payments for members of our subscription service.
* Measure and improve involuntary churn through systemic improvements, such as coordinating schedules, evaluating new recurring billing products, and assessing different payment processors.
* Develop a roadmap with our finance and engineering teams to prioritize projects and monitoring systems to track renewals and disbursements.

*Monitoring & Reporting*

* Conceptualize and spec detailed reports that allow you to monitor these systems at a granular level, down to every individual member and order.
* Operate on the instinct that if you cannot measure it, you do not know it is happening correctly.

**About you...**

* 5+ years of experience in a product management role, ideally in transactional product management processing large volumes of orders. E-commerce or subscription experience is required; both is ideal.
* Bachelor's degree, likely in a technical discipline.
* Strong technical skills and deep experience working with engineers to spec technical systems.
* Excellent at communicating technical information to different audiences.
* A rare combination of technical depth and customer obsession: these systems directly shape how members experience our product, and you need a real sense for the customer experience you want, plus the ability to translate it into something engineering can build.
* Exceptionally high attention to detail. In a renewal system, five errors is a huge number of errors, and you care about getting it right down to the individual human.

Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000

The Product Manager will drive product planning and execution across Credibly's lending platform: the experiences our merchants and broker partners use to apply and get funded, the internal tools our sales, underwriting, funding, and servicing teams rely on every day, and the data and integrations that connect it all.

You will connect customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility; decide what to build and why; and lead cross-functional teams through discovery, delivery, and launch. You will use data to measure what works, and you will look for practical ways that automation and AI can make our products faster, smarter, and easier to use.

* Comfort with data; working knowledge of SQL and BI tools is strongly preferred
* Enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers, including understanding AP

jobs.desc:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for a digital product initiative, operating within Agile/Scrum frameworks. The role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — most engagements in this market are technical-delivery-adjacent (software, data, or AI products) rather than purely strategic, so comfort partnering closely with engineering is expected.

  • Own the product backlog, prioritization, and roadmap using Agile/Scrum practices
  • Translate business and stakeholder needs into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to scope, sequence, and deliver iteratively
  • Define and track success metrics/KPIs for the product area
  • Facilitate or support Agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews) alongside a Scrum Master where applicable
  • (Common variant, ~1 in 5 postings) Own AI/Agentic feature delivery — defining how GenAI or agentic capabilities integrate into the product
