  • (Frequent industry context) CPG/enterprise data-product ownership — managing data platforms, catalogs, or analytics products feeding business stakeholders


Required Skills (Must-Have)

  • Agile Product Management — backlog ownership, iterative delivery, Scrum/Kanban fluency
  • Proven Product Manager, Product Owner, or Technical PM experience
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration (engineering, data, business)
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable product requirements


Nice to Have

  • AI/GenAI or Agentic product experience (increasingly common — nearly 1 in 5 current postings)
  • Data product management experience (catalogs, analytics platforms, BI)
  • CPG, enterprise, or regulated-industry domain experience
  • Technical fluency (APIs, data architecture) for Technical PM-flavored roles

**Who You Are**

You are a highly analytical professional that operates at the interface of Product Management and Data Science.. You understand that a model's value depends only on how well it solves a real customer problem. You can translate a use case into a clear prediction target, define what constitutes a true positive, and reason through the tradeoffs between missed risk and unnecessary alerts. You are comfortable discussing precision, recall, and ROC analysis with data scientists, and explaining what those metrics mean to customers.

You are drawn to the intersection of product strategy and applied machine learning. You know how to turn customer needs into model requirements, evaluate whether an improvement matters in practice, and prioritize new capabilities alongside improvements to existing models. You are rigorous and analytical, but you move with urgency and make practical decisions with imperfect information.

You are collaborative by nature and have achieved success as a team player. You thrive by setting ambitious goals and tracking progress until they are met. You feel strongly about being mission-driven in your work, and above all else you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things.

**Who We Are**

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world's biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind's Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.

Our customers need to understand the intelligence they rely on: what our models assess, how their performance is measured, and where their limitations lie. The Core Models product area connects the development of our models to those customer needs and the workflows they support.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family-friendly work-life balance.

**What A Great Candidate Looks Like:**

* BS or MS in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field, or bring equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of product management, data science, and/or data analytics experience working with software powered by machine learning models or with significant model-driven capabilities.
* You have a strong working command of classifier performance metrics, including precision, recall, false-positive and false-negative rates, and ROC analysis and can interpret evaluation results, explain threshold tradeoffs, and connect those tradeoffs to customer outcomes.
* You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a well-defined model use case, prediction target, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* You understand how label quality, class imbalance, and the representativeness of evaluation data affect conclusions about model performance.
* You are comfortable partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering, distinguishing product decisions from modeling implementation choices while contributing meaningfully to both discussions.
* You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical audiences and can explain model capabilities and limitations without overstating what the evidence supports.
* You understand agile software

**Innovate with purpose**

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters.

**Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company**

Join BILL as a Product Manager on our Risk Product team and help shape how customers and employees experience risk at BILL. Every day, legitimate businesses hit a verification step, a payment hold, a limit, or a review. Our Risk Product team owns both sides of that moment: the customer-facing Risk Experiences that explain what is happening and get customers moving again, and Risk Central, the fraud monitoring and case management platform that Risk Operations rely on to review alerts across AP, AR, and Spend & Expense.

In this role, you'll own a defined part of the Risk Experiences and Risk Central roadmap, taking features and workflows from problem definition through launch and iteration while partnering closely with design, engineering, risk operations, and risk strategy. Your work will make risk moments clear and quick for the SMBs who rely on BILL to pay vendors, collect from customers, and manage spend, and will help analysts review cases faster and with fewer errors, so fewer legitimate customers get held up and fewer fraudulent accounts get through.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own a defined area of the Risk Experiences and Risk Central roadmap, such as customer verification and document collection flows, hold and review notifications, self-service resolution, analyst queues, or case workflows, from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Design customer-facing risk experiences that reduce friction, confusion, and drop-off for legitimate businesses while holding the line on fraud, partnering with design on flows, messaging, and in-product communication.
* Write clear product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and rollout plans that engineering teams can build from.
* Partner with risk operations, customer support, and risk strategy to understand where customers get stuck and how analysts work, and turn both into prioritized improvements.
* Drive day-to-day execution with engineering across sprint planning, dependency tracking, and launch readiness, including consolidating legacy case workflows into Risk Central.
* Define and track metrics for your area, including customer-side measures such as verification completion, time to resolution, and support contact rate, and operations measures such as review time, error rates, and queue backlog, balanced against fraud loss and false positives.
* Draft a half-year roadmap proposal for your area and raise risks early, with options for how to handle them.
* Use data, customer research, and analyst feedback to decide what to build next, running before and after analysis on every release.
* Use AI tools in your daily work for research, writing, and analysis, and help evaluate where automatio

**About the Role**  
The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. The role aligns priorities across multiple teams into one clear, sequenced plan, sets the standard for what “ready for engineering” means, and makes sure the work being built is the work that matters most. It operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the primary point of accountability for stakeholder alignment across engineering, client services, sales, marketing, and operations, and it drives cross-team decisions to documented outcomes.  
  
**What You'll Do**

**Stakeholder Management & Outcomes**

* Own stakeholder management for the product area: identify key stakeholders, set expectations, manage communication cadence, and be the single point of accountability for alignment. What You'll Do
* Gather priorities from engineering, client services, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership and reconcile them into one shared, sequenced roadmap
* Surface conflicting priorities early, put the tradeoffs in front of the right decision-makers, and drive them to a documented resolution
* Run regular alignment touchpoints (roadmap reviews, priority check-ins, stakeholder updates) so changes in direction are communicated before they become surprises.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and external partners so that every open item has a named owner, a next step, and a follow-up cadence.
* Escalate with a clear recommendation when a decision belongs above the team.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap aligned to company objectives.
* Lead discovery with client services, sales, and business stakeholders to identify the underlying problems behind requests and validate opportunities before committing to work.

**Requirements & Specification**

* Translate business ideas into clear technical requirements — most requests arrive as a business problem, not a deliverable, and it's in this role to determine what's actually needed and who else needs to weigh in.
* Own backlog health so work arrives at planning well-defined, right-sized, and sequenced against the roadmap.
* Write and maintain requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases precise enough that engineering can build without re-litigating scope.
* Partner with engineering on feasibility and technical approach early, and make scope decisions when tradeoffs arise mid-delivery while keeping stakeholders informed of the impact.

**Process & Standards**

* Define and evolve how intake, refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder acceptance work for the team, adjusting as team size, cadence, and product needs change.
* Partner with engineering to maintain accurate documentation and decision records so past decisions remain traceable.
* Identify recurring friction in how work moves between teams and drive fixes rather than workarounds.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, CRM, lead generation, or insurance/fintech.
* Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.
* Track record of owning a product area’s roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes.

The Product Manager owns the strategy, vision, operating model, and roadmap for assigned products, capabilities, or enterprise transformation initiatives. This role translates business, customer, regulatory, operational, and technology objectives into prioritized, phased delivery plans; establishes governance, milestones, readiness criteria, and success measures; and coordinates cross-functional teams and third parties through implementation, stabilization, and transition to operational ownership.

* Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, operating model, governance framework, success criteria, standards, and reusable templates.
* Translate business, customer, regulatory, operational, and technology objectives into prioritized initiatives and phased delivery plans.

* Define milestones, decision points, acceptance criteria, and readiness measures from planning through implementation and stabilization.
* Establish the roadmap and governance cadence, including review, re-baselining, decision-making, and reporting to executive and working teams.

**Job Description:**

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

  

The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible.

  

They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. This is a hybrid role

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to maximize organizational efficiency.

* Proven experience in product management, particularly with analytical solutions.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.
* Demonstrated ability in group problem solving and strategic execution.
* Proficiency in computer literacy, including advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with marketing and customer engagement strategies.

Strong researching abilities to inform product decisions and market understanding.

jobs.desc:
Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss.  
Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis.

* We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011
* Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight
* Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote

**About Bitsight**
------------------

Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader. We help companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Global enterprises, governments, and organizations rely on Bitsight to prioritize cybersecurity investments, build trust within their ecosystem, and reduce the chance of financial loss.

We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011. Over 3,500 customers trust Bitsight. Our team of more than 600 people works from Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote locations around the world.

**About the Role**
------------------

Bitsight's engineering organization is changing fast. AI tools now write and review a growing share of our code, and the path from ticket to shipped change is shifting with them. We need a Technical Product Manager to help prioritize and coordinate execution on improvements to our process.

You will work closely with our engineering and AI subject matter expert teams.You will coordinate the work needed to improve and adopt AI-supported engineering workflows, bringing developer feedback, evidence, and open decisions to the people responsible for them.

**What You'll Do**

  

* Work with engineering and product leaders to agree on priorities, team participation, and the changes needed to put those priorities into practice. Bring product context into engineering discussions, and bring developers’ feedback into product decisions. Work with engineering teams day to day on priorities, process, and how AI fits into their workflow.
* Contribute to the AI SDLC roadmap. Gather input from engineers, surface high-impact use cases for AI in coding, review, testing, and documentation, and help shape priorities with the product and engineering leads.
* Coordinate work on the AI code reviewer. Help teams and its engineering owners agree on needs, priorities, delivery plans, and follow-up.
* Track the flow of work from ticket to merge request (MR). Spot gaps and bottlenecks, and work with teams to close them.
* Help engineering teams and product partners agree on quality expectations for AI-generated code edits. Track outcomes against those expectations, flag trends, and follow up with the accountable owners.
* Analyze where time goes across the SDLC. Pull the data, identify the biggest sources of delay, and recommend fixes.
* Support adoption of AI tooling across engineering. Collect feedback, work with internal champions, and report on how teams are using the tools.
* Work with security, compliance, and architecture partners so AI adoption stays safe and consistent with our policies.
* Help update Bitsight's product process to fit an AI-driven SDLC, documenting changes and rolling them out.
* Support the AI subject matter expert (SME) team with planning, prioritization, and coordinating their work with engineering teams.

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Experience as a software engineer. You have written and shipped production code and can hold your own in technical conversations with engineers.
* Familiarity with the SDLC, from idea to ticket to code to release.
* Strong organizational and project management skills. You can track many small, concurrent workstreams without dropping any.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Normal Computing | Build with Us**
------------------------------------

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), London, Copenhagen, and Seoul.

**The Role**
------------

As an early-career Product Manager, you'll work with the Product Lead and the engineering teams to help build the AI systems and autoresearch platform our ASIC team needs to tapeout unconventional, physics-based architecture. We are rethinking the chip design system from the ground up, automating the process of research: exploring the full design space, generating candidate architectures, evaluating them at appropriate levels of fidelity, and feeding learnings from experiments run in hardware labs and deployed silicon into the next generation chip. Domains of exploration include RTL optimization, design verification, and continual learning from experiment results. You'll help decide what we build, then be accountable for delivering on the incremental milestones to tapeout.

On any given day, you might sit with a chip architect benchmarking novel architectures, shadow a verification debug session and come back with a proposal for what to automate, scope out the requirements and success criteria for a custom EDA tool, or prototype an experiment dashboard. This is a building role. You'll write specs, run experiments, and use coding agents to prototype and land fixes yourself. When you have an idea, we would rather you spend an afternoon prototyping a rough version than a week describing it.

No semiconductor background is required to start. In your first few months the bar is understanding how the team works, asking the questions that move a design discussion forward, and earning trust by following through on deliverables.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **AI tooling scope:** Investigate where the ASIC team's time actually goes, decide what we build, then be accountable for whether it gets used.
* **Specs and prototypes:** Write the requirements docs and user journeys that engineering builds from. Where a working prototype communicates faster than a document, build the prototype instead.
* **Prototype to production:** Work with engineers to turn a promising prototype into something the ASIC team can rely on.
* **Shipping small changes:** Work in the codebase with coding agents, open PRs for bug fixes or UI changes, learn from code reviews from engineers, and develop judgment about which changes are yours to make.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* A degree in CS, EE, physics, math, or similar, or the equivalent taught to yourself.
* 1-3 years of experience in product management, engineering, research, technical program management, or a related technical role.
* You can point to something that was your idea and that you made real.
* Fluency with coding agents. You already use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or something similar as a normal part of how you work.
* Experience building or evaluating LLM-powered products.
* Clarity of communication in both speaking and writing.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Much of what you work on will be underspecified. You should be able to take a vague problem, frame it, and come back with a proposal.
* Interest in how chips are designed.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Coursework, research, or internship experience in chip architectures, digital design, verification, or hardware performance modeling.
* Exposure to SystemVerilog.
* Familiarity with the mechanisms underlying LLM inference

***Equal Employment Opportunity Statement***

*Normal Computing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all

What We Need
  
  
CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Product Manager within our North American Trucking division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Atlanta, GA.
  
  
Corpay's North American Trucking team operates differently than a typical large enterprise product organization. While we're part of a global company, our team runs with the speed, ownership, and accountability of a startup.
  
  
We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by ambiguity, thrives with autonomy, and enjoys building products and businesses from the ground up. This isn't a role where you are given a roadmap, you'll define your own way, drive alignment, and own execution from concept through launch and beyond.
  
  
One day you may be interviewing customers and writing product requirements. The next you might be reviewing UI designs, developing go-to-market materials, negotiating strategic partnerships, analyzing product performance, or working with engineering to solve technical challenges. Success requires someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute.
  
If you're looking for a role with clearly defined boundaries, this probably isn't it. If you're excited by ownership, variety, and building products that make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP of Connected Vehicle Products and regularly collaborate with the team and other departments.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Product Manager, you will be expected to work in an office environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:
  

* Assigned workspace in the Buckhead Atlanta office.
* Company-issued equipment + remote access

* Driving product strategy and execution. Identify opportunities through customer research, market insights, data analysis, and internal collaboration, then translate those opportunities into actionable roadmaps and product plans.
* Leading product development. Define requirements, write epics and user stories, prioritize backlogs, make trade-off decisions, and partner closely with engineering to deliver high-quality solutions across both modern platforms and legacy systems.
* Being the voice of the customer. Develop a deep understanding of carriers, drivers, fleet operators, and internal users to ensure we're solving meaningful problems with intuitive, scalable solutions.
* Shaping the user experience. Collaborate with UX and engineering to review designs, simplify workflows, and create exceptional customer experiences across web, mobile, and internal applications.
* Bringing products to market. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, and Training to develop positioning, launch plans, enablement materials, and adoption strategies that maximize product success.
* Using data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously iterate based on customer feedback, analytics, and business results.
* Leading through influence. Build alignment across Engineering, Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, and executive leadership to move initiatives forward in a highly collaborative environment.
* Wearing multiple hats. This role extends well beyond traditional product management. On any given day, you may be writing product requirements, reviewing UI designs, developing marketing content, supporting customer conversations, negotiating partnerships, or solving operational challenges. We value people who embrace variety and are willing to jump in wherever needed.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, New Products
jobs.desc:
About Us

Our purpose is to increase economic opportunity and make better money. We’re doing that through two connected parts that together make up the Reserve project.

Economic Opportunity

UGLYCASH is a financial services app designed around the needs of people earning money on the internet: creators, remote workers, freelancers, and entrepreneurs whose banks weren’t built for how they earn.

We’re starting in Latin America. Over the last 22 months, UGLYCASH has reached $5M+ in revenue run rate and 32,000+ monthly active customers.

This is the side of the Reserve project you’ll be working on.

Better Money

What happens to that money after you earn it matters too.

Cash, money in a bank account, and payment stablecoins each work differently. We believe the money people use should do more than move from one place to another. It should also give people a better way to save and grow what they earn.

That’s why we’re continuing to improve the version of money UGLYCASH customers already use, with the long term goal of giving more people access to better options for their money.

Check us out:

Instagram

Youtube

X

**Description**

We're looking for someone early in their product career who has already found ways to make things happen.

You'll work directly with founders to explore and build new financial products. Our founders bring vision and hypotheses. You'll help turn them into products through customer understanding, evidence, experimentation, and execution.

We're hiring for the product owner you can become over the next 24 months, not the title you already have. You'll start with a focused opportunity, experienced people around you, and real responsibility. As your judgment grows, so will the size of the problems you own.

If you want to learn how new products go from an idea to something thousands of people actually use, this is the kind of seat that's hard to find.

What you could build

* Ways to earn, receive, and use money: Better payment collection, deposit experiences, and money movement for internet earners.
* Credit: New ways to make useful credit products available to more customers and markets.
* Activation and growth: Helping customers understand UGLYCASH's value and start using it.
* Products for specific customer groups: Building experiences for freelancers, online entrepreneurs, creators, and other communities with distinct financial needs.

These are examples of where the work could lead. Your first assignment will be a focused opportunity selected with the founders.

What you'll do

* Talk to customers, study their behavior, and figure out which problems are worth solving.
* Turn founder hypotheses into testable approaches and manageable first versions.
* Bring evidence that strengthens an idea or changes it.
* Use AI to research, analyze, prototype, and shorten the path from idea to useful learning.
* Work closely with engineering and design to take ideas from concept through launch.
* Measure what happens after something ships and use what you learn to make it better.
* Build the judgment to own increasingly ambitious product opportunities over time.

  
**Requirements**

You don't need a previous PM title or fintech resume.

We're looking for evidence of initiative, clear thinking, curiosity, and fast learning. Show us something you've built, improved, or taken responsibility for. It could come from a job, small business, coursework, personal project, or something you created independently.

You're curious about customers and the economics behind a product. You're comfortable with numbers, can explain your reasoning, respond to feedback, and know when to ask for help. Most importantly, you care whether an idea actually creates value for someone.

You've used AI to make something useful, whether that's a prototype, analysis, automation, tool, or other concrete result. You can explain your choices, identify mistakes, and improve the output.

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.desc:
Points North is looking for an Associate Product Owner to drive hands on execution for partner integrations for an established B2B software application that streamlines complex payroll calculations and compliance reporting for companies with prevailing wage and unionized workforces.  
  
This is an individual contributor role where you will be responsible for developing a keen understanding and expertise of our existing systems, building requirements for integrations, and helping drive our connectivity initiatives. You will be responsible for working directly with our partners to ensure that requirements are accurate and complete. You will work cross functionally with Engineering, QA, Implementation, Support, Managed Services, and domain SMEs, and you will have direct customer access. As a result, you will play a critical role in our continued growth, helping our clients better automate their data flow.  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Own requirements, documentation and outcomes for integrations with our partners, along with day-to-day product decisions for integration design in alignment with our overall company objectives.
* Translate integration needs into clear product workflows, API requirements, data mapping expectations, and operational support considerations.
* Define measurable outcomes and priorities that balance stability and retention, customer value, and modernization.
* Write epics, user stories, and detailed acceptance criteria that engineers and QA can build and test against with confidence.
* Participate in our Agile product development process.
* Use data and feedback loops (support trends, customer escalations, implementation insights, adoption signals, partner feedback) to improve the integration experience and retention.
* Coordinate and deliver release communications (what changed, who it impacts, why it matters, how to use it) related to integrations.

  
In the first 6-12 months you will have:

* Built strong working knowledge of our platform and the real-world customer workflows it supports.
* The role of integrations in our clients’ lifecycle and as a retention driver is clearly understood and reflected in a focused, outcome-based roadmap.
* Integrations are being built from a solidified plan with testing and user experience across multiple clients incorporated prior to official release.

  
**What We Are Looking For:**

* Proven ability to be a strong individual contributor: owning outcomes end to end process from discovery to delivery to results
* Excellent written communication (clear requirements, decision logs, release notes, stakeholder updates).
* Track record of working with Engineering and QA, with comfort going deep into edge cases, tradeoffs, and technical constraints.
* Familiarity (not necessarily expertise) with one or more of: Prevailing wage/union compliance (federal/state/local) OR Construction payroll/compliance operations
* You like being close to the work: writing, refining, triaging, talking to customers, and shipping continuously.
* Enjoy working collaboratively across cross functional teams and with partners.
* Prefer execution over authority or managing a team.
* Are energized by complexity and can translate it into simple, usable experiences.

  
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field; or equivalent and relevant working experience
* 2+ years professional experience in product management with B2B SaaS products

* 1+ years’ experience working closely with partners on integrations to ensure mutual success.
* 1+ years' experience in regulated domains where accuracy and explainability are critical (payroll, tax, HR, compliance, fintech).
* Demonstrated capability and experience defining and delivering API based integrations, including understanding:
* Integration patterns (REST APIs, webhooks, file-based interchange where applicable)
* Data mapping/validation, error handling, reconciliation, and operational

jobs.desc:
**Reports to: Project Manager (OMS) and Project Manager (Gateway/FirstClose One)**

**Department: Product**

**Location: Remote**

FirstClose is a leading provider of fintech solutions that streamline the home equity and mortgage lending process for banks, credit unions, and lenders nationwide. As we continue to expand and enhance our core products, we’re looking for the right candidate to help drive that growth.

As an Associate Product Manager, you will be responsible for supporting the evolution and adoption of FirstClose’s order management systems for third-party settlement and verification services (OMS/FirstClose One) and vendor marketplace platform (Gateway). Your work will involve managing complex provider integrations, lender workflows, and internal orchestration logic across the platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Development**

* Translate provider, lender, and internal needs into clear requirements and user stories.
* Support design reviews for OMS workflows, cascades, and Gateway provider flows.
* Assist PMs with rule mapping (eligibility, routing, valuation logic).
* Maintain shared backlogs across OMS + Gateway, ensuring clarity and prioritization.

**Product Delivery**

* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and/or coordinate UAT with lenders, internal Ops, and providers.
* Create release notes, user guides and operational support documentation for product enhancements
* Validate provider integration behaviors (ordering, responses, error handling).
* Support delivery of OMS migration waves (config, testing, readiness).
* Track rollout tasks, dependencies, and communicate risk early.

**Product Support**

* Triage provider-related issues (latency, data mismatch, SLA breaches).
* Reproduce and document defects for engineering.
* Support Ops, Support, and Implementation teams with issue analysis and configuration help.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 1–3 years of experience in SaaS product work, business analysis/product ownership, provider integrations, fintech, or lending operations
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to map and optimize complex workflows
* Solid understanding of APIs, structured data formats, and rules-based orchestration
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Atlassian Jira for backlog management and cross-team coordination
* Experience working on Agile product teams
* Experience with vendor performance management, including order-level audit and issue resolution
* Hands-on experience managing third-party provider relationships and integration requirements
* Familiarity with billing workflows, reconciliation processes, and vendor invoicing models

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Our Mission**
---------------

As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.

(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026)

**Day to Day**
--------------

You'll own capabilities at the foundation of how the company moves, stores, and reasons about data: collecting analytical events in real time and batch, housing them cost-efficiently across thousands of datasets, and making them queryable at massive scale. Your focus is building paved paths, opinionated end-to-end workflows, that let teams produce trusted data outcomes without stitching together systems, filing tickets, or becoming amateur platform engineers. You'll be accountable for the full user-facing capability across whatever products it touches, absorbing the friction from start to finish. You'll build these paths alongside your customers, working with engineers on the technical design and with internal users, so decisions rest on real use cases and direct feedback. Expect to stay hands-on: tracing how data flows end-to-end, finding where paths break down, and shifting more of the work from procedural steps to simple, declarative intent.

Making the platform AI-ready is core to the role. You'll shape how data is exposed to AI systems and agents through natural-language access, programmatic access, and AI-assisted analysis, and you'll hold those capabilities to the same governance, quality, and observability bar as everything else. You're also expected to use AI fluently in your own work: speeding up discovery and analysis, prototyping and pressure-testing ideas, drafting specs, synthesizing customer feedback, and automating workflows so you spend more time on the product strategy.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with engineering teams and other interested parties to prioritize and manage roadmaps for delivering toward product vision incrementally and efficiently.
* Communicate roadmap and product plan to and get alignment with leadership, collaborators and interested parties.
* Be the face of the customer internally, advocating for, and representing their needs, opportunities, and product requirements.
* Identify, and monitor product goals and success metrics.
* Iterate quickly to launch new features and make data-driven judgments to test their efficacy.
* Provide clear written and verbal updates on the roadmap and progress toward goals to leadership and collaborators.

**Skills/Competencies**
-----------------------

* Requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English
* Experience working closely with engineers to define, plan, and build products and features
* Data-driven mindset
* Deep curiosity and accountability for the data and insights of their products.

**Salary Range Transparency**
-----------------------------

Tier 2 - United States of America 96,000 - 144,000 USD per year

**Salary Range Disclaimer**
---------------------------

*At this time, we are only considering candidates for this role who are based in the following locations: Austin, TX*

The salary range for this role reflects the minimum and maximum compensation for the role. Offers are typically made between the range minimum and the range midpoint. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process. The range(s) listed is just one component of Indeed's total compensation package for employees. jobs.desc:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Takes the lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks. Utilizes basic understanding of the business vision and requires frequent support and direction from the Product Manager and/or Product Owner II or III.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes basic business knowledge and communication skills to anticipate problems, address them accordingly while working cross functionally in a self-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Provides ongoing refinement of team backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Participates in PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution Participates in Inspect <(>&<)> Adapt (I<(>&<)>A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, actively gaining knowledge on the matter. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end-user needs in mind to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Performs other duties as assigned.

As a **Controls Room Product Owner (Associate)**, you will support the product strategy and delivery for our products, enabling effective oversight and execution across the control environment. The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The Associate Product Manager, Product Marketing supports the Product Manager or Senior Product Manager overseeing the assigned product line with competitive tracking, market share analysis, and opportunity sizing — the analytical foundation used to make roadmap and investment decisions. In a segment too small to warrant a dedicated Senior Product Manager, reports directly to the Director, Product Marketing instead. Does not own P&L or carry independent decision authority

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Put safety first – Always!
* Lead and foster our “people first” culture.
* Conduct ongoing competitive landscape tracking and category share analysis for the assigned product line
* Size new product and partnership opportunities — market size, addressable segments, estimated share capture — to support business case development
* Support analysis and interpretation of consumer and contractor research to help identify unmet needs for the assigned line

**Job Description:**

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

  

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

  

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

  

***WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (Job Overview):***

The Humanitarian Services Product Management team aspires to create human-centered digital experiences for our clients and workforce and to ensure our digital products support successful mission delivery. Our products support our humanitarian mission in many ways, including delivering financial assistance to those impacted by disasters, visualizing situational awareness for disaster response and logistics operations, and onboarding and assigning volunteers to critical mission roles.

  

**About Our Contact Center and Operations Platforms:**

This role supports a portfolio of 24x7 contact center platforms serving Disaster Relief, SAF Hero Care, and Fundraising operations. Built on AWS Amazon Connect and modern IVR technologies, these mission-critical systems help clients, donors, military families, volunteers, and responders access information, assistance, and support, especially during periods of crisis and large-scale disaster activity. The product portfolio integrates with numerous business systems and focuses on delivering compassionate, high-quality client experiences while driving operational efficiency, workforce productivity, and service excellence. The team is actively advancing automation, AI, intelligent routing, agent assist, and digital self-service capabilities to improve both client outcomes and operational performance.

**The Position:**

We are seeking a Product Manager to own and evolve our Contact Center platform — the technology and experience layer that powers workforce productivity, real-time operational insight, and AI-enabled service delivery across our contact center and chapter network. This role sits at the intersection of agent experience, customer/client experience, and AI innovation, and is responsible for ensuring that every call, chat, and interaction path is efficient, intelligent, and easy to navigate — for both the people answering and the people calling.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable diving into IVR call-flow logic and phone routing architecture as they define a roadmap for AI-assisted coaching, sentiment analysis, and generative summarization. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring close partnership with contact center operations, chapter/field offices, engineering, data science, and telephony vendors.

jobs.desc:
**About Lumafield:**

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA.

**About the role:**

Lumafield is looking for a passionate and driven Associate Product Manager (Hardware) to work with our hardware, software, and manufacturing teams. The Lumafield product team is full stack and high agency. You will identify and lead new product opportunities for on-scanner software and hardware capabilities within the Lab Solutions team. This includes user research, market research, developing prototypes, developing product requirements, and developing internal tooling to make your initiatives successful.

This is an extremely collaborative role that will require meaningfully engaging with your engineering partners' areas of expertise (hardware design and manufacturing, electronics, embedded software) while also maintaining a business and market opportunity perspective including partnering with sales and marketing to lead new product capabilities from concept to commercial success.

  

### **What you'll do:**

* Perform market research, customer research, and competitor research to identify new applications and market opportunities.
* Conduct internal capabilities analysis with the internal R&D team to inform discovery work.
* Assist in defining new hardware product configurations and major features.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Product Teams.
* Communicate initial product insights and business justification to stakeholders across the organization.
* Seek out, analyze, and quantify user needs and product opportunities.
* Understand our customers and key industries completely.
* Provide a recommendation to leadership on go/no-go based on your insights and analysis.

### **About you:**

* 1-3 years of product, engineering or applications engineering experience
* Excellent written and verbal communicator with attention to detail where it matters.
* Can work equally effectively with collaborators across engineering, sales, and marketing.
* Can work fast and know how to prototype.

* Highly independent, but can seek guidance when you need it.
* Are decisive, even with incomplete information.
* Are known for following through.

* Knowledge in engineering and manufacturing industries.
* Experience developing and shipping software-driven hardware products.
* Skills or experience across go-to-market (sales, marketing, trade shows, video production).
* An interesting previous experience that gives you valuable insights in this new role.
